article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock carcasses pile up into mountains... Foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks in 12 central Chinese provinces! Authorities' one hardline move angers netizens: a truly Communist nation
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease, South African type, has erupted in 12 Chinese provinces, including Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, and the North/Northeast regions. The virus is highly airborne, prompting emergency market closures and strict livestock transport bans that have devastated the livestock sector. Live cattle and swine markets were shut; prices collapsed; farmers face slaughter or destocking with mortality risk in young stock exceeding 60%. Official information remains limited, but reports show images of carcasses and crowded markets with little activity. Enforcement by local authorities is described as heavy-handed, with allegations in Xinjiang that teams entered homes and injected animals with unknown drugs and removed unresponsive livestock, without transparently provided test results. The article provides no laboratory confirmation or data on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜の死骸が山積み...中国12省で口蹄疫が大発生！当局の強硬措置に怒る利用者：本当に共産主義国家
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。南アフリカ型FMDの12省での大規模発生は、対象国Chinaの畜産・食料安全保障に重大な影響を与え、隣接地域への越境感染リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 南アフリカ型FMDの12省への急速な拡大（新疆、内モンゴル、華北・東北地域を含む）は極めて異常。高い空気伝播性、60%以上の子畜死亡率、市場閉鎖・流通禁止による経済的影響は深刻。当局の強硬措置（未検証の薬物投与疑い）による国民的反発も注目。ただし記事は公式確認やラボ確認データに乏しく、続報とWHO/OIE通知の監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes harap penyakit ATM Papua Pegunungan ditangani secara serius - ANTARA News Kalimantan Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Health Ministry hopes the ATM disease in the Papua Highlands will be treated seriously.
article.articleSummary: AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria (ATM) in the Papua Highlands require serious, coordinated action to prevent deaths, according to Indonesia's Health Ministry via the Adinkes network. The Ministry urges provincial and district governments to push ATM programs for better central-local synchronization and elimination of the disease. Effective control depends on cross-sector government and community involvement, not just health agencies. The effort centers on six districts in Papua Highlands that currently receive Global Fund support for AIDS, TB, and malaria control. Those districts are Jayawijaya, Nduga, Yahukimo, Mamberamo Tengah, Yalimo, and Pegunungan Bintang. The program could be expanded beyond these districts, but Global Fund planning remains focused on the six loci. Security concerns have led to adjustments in intervention delivery, with activities consolidated in certain locations with approval from the central Adinkes.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、パプアハイランド地域のATM(エイズ・結核・マラリア)疾患の深刻な対応を期待
triage.triage_reason: 結核とマラリアの複合的な公衆衛生上の課題が報告されており、複数のWPRO基準に該当する可能性があるが、新規の急性発生というよりも既存の長期的な疾病管理プログラムの強化に関する記事であり、国際的拡大リスクや緊急性の評価に情報不足がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はATM(エイズ・結核・マラリア)の複合的な疾病管理に関する政策的声明であり、急性的な流行や新規検出ではなく、既存疾患の長期的対応強化を報告している。パプアハイランド地域の6地区でグローバルファンド支援を受けており、管理可能性の問題と長期的な曝露リスクが示唆される。情報不足のため詳細なリスク評価には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 1.254 pasien TBC di Lebak jalani pengobatan selama Januari-Maret - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,254 tuberculosis patients in Lebak undergo treatment during January-March - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleSummary: 1,254 tuberculosis patients in Lebak Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia, were undergoing treatment during January–March 2026, per the Lebak Health Office. This accounts for 21% of an estimated 5,927 positive TB cases for the period, with no deaths reported. Indonesia ranks second globally in TB burden after India. Diagnosis and treatment follow standards: all suspected TB cases (coughing >3 months) are screened, and confirmed TB patients receive 6–12 months of uninterrupted therapy. Before treatment, patients undergo Tes Cepat Molekuler (TCM) rapid molecular testing. Free treatment is provided under the Standard Minimal Service (SPM) and the Free Health Check Program (CKG). Public health measures emphasize Clean Living and Healthy Behavior (PHBS), ventilation, avoiding smoking/alcohol, and maintaining a clean environment. Weekly contact tracing and Thursday house screenings of TB contacts by local cadres aim to detect new cases early and ensure adherence, with family-led Medication Supervision (PMO) during the six-month regimen.

triage.headline_ja: レバック県における結核患者1,254人が1月から3月の間に治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: 結核の定期的な治療状況報告であり、異常な感染症事象ではない。死亡報告なく、治療が適切に実施されている状況であることから、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: インドネシアのバンテン州レバック県における結核患者の定期的な治療進捗報告。1月から3月の期間に1,254人が治療を受けており、死亡例なし。治療管理、接触者追跡、ルーチンの公衆衛生対策が確立されている。新規感染症アウトブレイクや異常な事象の兆候がなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ nguy kịch vì mắc bệnh tay chân miệng không triệu chứng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A child in critical condition due to asymptomatic hand-foot-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Two children in Vietnam presented with severe hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) linked to enterovirus EV71, treated at Ho Chi Minh City’s Nhi Dong 2 Hospital in April 2026. Case1: a 1-year-old boy from Dat Do, TPHCM, began with fever and sore throat, then developed a subtle rash; rapid deterioration with autonomic instability and respiratory failure requiring intubation, dialysis, and inotropes. After >3 days, condition improved with weaning to CPAP and ongoing neuro monitoring. Case2: a 3-year-old from Khanh Hoa Province started with fever and rash, later exhibited neurological signs; given IVIg, then deteriorated with fever 39°C, pulmonary edema, tachycardia up to 230/min, and hypoxemia, necessitating ventilation, dialysis, and vasopressors; after 6 hours stabilized and dialysis was discontinued after 3 days. Ho Chi Minh City CDC notes EV71 accounts for about 56% of samples in early 2026, with high virulence, fecal-oral and direct contact transmission, and potential for rapid CNS involvement and death within 12–24 hours without timely intervention.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病（症状なし）で危機的状態の子ども
triage.triage_reason: エンテロウイルス71型による重症手足口病の複数の小児患者報告であり、IHR基準（異常性・重症度）と WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行可能性・管理可能性）の複数に該当。ベトナムにおける高病原性EV71の流行兆候がある。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市のNhi Dong 2病院での重症患者の報告で、EV71が2026年初期にサンプルの約56%を占めており、高い病原性、12〜24時間以内に死亡の可能性がある。経口・直接接触感染であり、地域的な流行拡大のリスク有り。ただし国際的拡大の可能性については現時点で記事内に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito hotspots sting Nagpur
article.articleSummary: Nagpur's Lakadganj, Hanuman Nagar, Nehru Nagar and Mangalwari are high-risk zones for mosquitoes, with persistent Culex densities from January to March and early Aedes presence signaling dengue risk. January hotspots included Hanuman Nagar (33.66), Satranjipura (32.60) and Dhantoli (30.35); February saw Hanuman Nagar peak at 37.66, Lakadganj 33.07 and Mangalwari 32.08. By March, Lakadganj (37.43), Nehru Nagar (36.11) and Mangalwari (36.09) remained top densities, with Gandhibagh (28.37) and Dhantoli (34.16) also breeding. Aedes indices persisted in Dharampeth (1.58) and Hanuman Nagar (1.47); Anopheles stephensi appeared in Gandhibagh (0.02) and Lakadganj (0.10), indicating malaria risk. Between January and March, two malaria, four chikungunya and 10 dengue cases were reported, with underreporting suspected. Despite 216 hours in Gandhibagh and 108 hours in Dhantoli, outcomes remained uneven, signaling fragmented control and rising risk as temperatures rise.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の温床がナグプールを襲う
triage.triage_reason: インドのナグプール地域で複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）が同時に発生しており、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさが複数該当する。蚊密度の高い地域が特定されており、今後の拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事では2026年4月の配信日付となっているが、本文の統計は1月から3月の期間データを示している。蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）が同時に検出されており、蚊ベクター種（Culex、Aedes、Anopheles stephensi）が複数確認されている。アンダーレポーティングの可能性も指摘されており、実際の症例数はさらに多い可能性がある。気温上昇に伴う今後のリスク増加が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Poliomyelitis revisited
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis is a paralytic viral disease caused by poliovirus (Enterovirus, Picornaviridae). Evidence traces to ancient Egypt; a 1789 clinical description and a 1894 Vermont outbreak of 132 cases. The virus was identified in 1908; three strains were described in 1930. Jonas Salk’s inactivated polio vaccine was developed in 1953 and became the US-recommended immunization by 1999. Africa was declared wild poliovirus–free in August 2020, with Nigeria likewise. In 2003 polio was endemic in India, Niger, Pakistan, Afghanistan and Egypt, with later importations to polio-free countries. Transmission is fecal–oral and via infected mucus; virus shedding occurs in throat and stool, with June–September peaks in areas with low immunization and poor sanitation. There is no cure; treatment is supportive, including respiratory support and physical therapy. Risk groups include the very young, pregnant women, the immunocompromised, and travelers to endemic areas such as Pakistan and Afghanistan.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオミエリティスの再考
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、記事は歴史的背景と現在の地域状況を述べているが、具体的な新規発生事例、患者数、死亡事例の報告がなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にポリオの歴史的背景、生物学、伝播様式、およびリスク集団についての教育的内容である。具体的な現在進行中のアウトブレイク、新規症例報告、または流行の兆候は記載されていない。インドは過去の地風土病地域として言及されているが、現在の発生状況は不明。パキスタンとアフガニスタンも地風土病地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 已出现相关病例 正是高峰期！武汉疾控提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Related cases have already appeared—this is the peak period! Wuhan CDC reminds.
article.articleSummary: Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) has been reported in Wuhan, with cases. As of 1 April 2026, SFTS is designated a Class B infectious disease under China’s Law on Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases, triggering enhanced prevention and control measures. SFTS is tick-borne; symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, and thrombocytopenia, with elderly and those with underlying illness at higher risk of severe disease, multi-organ failure, bleeding, and death. Tick activity peaks April–July; ticks have been found in grasslands, woodlands, shrubs, and parks, and can be carried by birds and pets. Prevention includes wearing protective clothing, using repellents (DEET or permethrin), avoiding prolonged exposure in grassy areas, and checking for ticks after outdoor activities. If bitten, remove carefully with tweezers, disinfect, and seek medical care within 14 days if symptoms appear. Transmission can occur via contact with patient blood or secretions. Patriotic Health Month emphasizes cleaning and pet protection.

triage.headline_ja: 関連事例がすでに報告されている—これはピーク時期です！武漢疾病管理センターより注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 中国（湖北省武漢）でSFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）の症例が報告され、Class B感染症として指定されている。ダニ媒介性疾患であり、4-7月にピークを迎え、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（患者の血液・分泌物接触）、高齢者と基礎疾患患者での重症化リスク、多臓器不全・出血・死亡のリスクを示している。中国当局が広く注意喚起を行っている点から、公衆衛生的影響が大きいと評価される。
triage.notes: SFTSはダニ媒介性疾患であり、4-7月のダニ活動ピークに対応した時期的な注意喚起。患者の血液・分泌物への接触によるヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が明記されており、ダニ媒介以外の伝播経路も存在する。中国が Class B 感染症として公式に指定し、防除対策強化を実施中。情報源がIFeng（中国最大規模のニュース配信プラットフォーム）であり、国内での社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: سمندری غذائوں میں وائرس آنکھوں کی بیماری کا سبب بن رہا ہے،تحقیق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study: A virus in seafood is causing an eye disease.
article.articleSummary: On 12 April 2026, researchers in China linked Covert Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV) — previously known to infect shrimp and other seafood — to a human ocular disease named Persistent Ocular Hypertension Viral Anterior Uveitis (POH-VAU). CMNV DNA/RNA was detected in eye tissues of affected patients, and several cases reported recent exposure to raw seafood or aquatic animals. If confirmed, CMNV would be the first marine-origin virus implicated in human eye disease, posing a potential future public health problem. The report does not provide case counts or outbreak data; it underscores the need for further laboratory confirmation and surveillance to assess zoonotic spillover and possible human-to-human transmission, and to determine whether seafood exposure is the infection source.

triage.headline_ja: 研究: 海産物のウイルスが眼病を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: 新規の人獣共通感染症の可能性（海産由来ウイルスが初めて人間の眼疾患と関連付けられた）と異常性は認められるが、症例数・流行データが報告されておらず、さらなる検査確認が必要な段階。情報が限定的であり、現時点ではWATCH相当。
triage.notes: 記事は研究論文の報告であり、具体的な症例数、死亡数、流行規模が報告されていない。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性については言及されているものの、現段階では確認されていない。海産物経由の感染源であるか確定していない。さらなる検査確認と疫学調査の必要性が強調されている。新規の人獣共通感染症である点と異常性から WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: 28 fogging machines defunct,mosquito menace plagues city
article.articleSummary: Nagpur's malaria and filaria department reports 28 of 51 hand fogging machines defunct or awaiting repairs, with 19 under repairs and 9 condemned, leaving 27 working. A shortfall of 17 machines and a demand gap for 17 more undermine vector control as malaria, dengue and other vector-borne diseases loom ahead of the monsoon. The crisis is worst in Mangalwari (1 of 7 working), Hanuman Nagar (2 of 5), and Lakadganj (2 of 4). Spraying units total 126 (demand gap 45); vehicle-mounted machines 11 (including HQ), all but one in use on main roads. Interior localities remain exposed. Residents report inequities in fogging, with calls for broader coverage. Health committee chairperson Manisha Atkare orders at least one fogging round per prabhag weekly and urges coordination with corporators to prioritise mosquito-prone pockets, though non-functional machinery hampers implementation.

triage.headline_ja: 28台の霧撃機が使用不能、蚊害が市を悩ます
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング熱といった重要な疾患が関連し、ベクターコントロール体制の脆弱性が報告されているが、現時点では具体的な患者数増加や重症化の報告がなく、情報が管理面の課題に限定されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナグプール市の媒介動物制御体制の脆弱性（霧撃機の故障・不足）であり、実際の患者数増加や死亡の報告はない。モンスーン前のマラリア・デング熱の流行予防という文脈で懸念が指摘されているが、現時点は体制的課題の段階。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（interior localitiesが媒介動物リスクにさらされている）と「流行しやすさ」（モンスーン前の季節性、ヒト-蚊-ヒト感染）が該当。地方自治体の関心も記録されている。続報の動きを注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: The Economic and Health Burden of Chikungunya Virus in Brazil (2011-2020) - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded 3.2 million chikungunya virus (CHIKV) cases from 2011–2020, with an economic and health burden of US$9.8 billion. A cost-effectiveness analysis evaluates vaccination for adults 18+ using live-attenuated and recombinant vaccines, implemented through a modified Susceptible-Vaccinated-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered-Deceased model to reduce CHIKV impact. The work frames CHIKV within the broader vector-borne disease challenge and references 2019 Global Burden of Disease estimates: dengue 2.38 million DALYs, yellow fever 290,000 DALYs, Zika 347 DALYs. Authors note that global CHIKV burden is likely underestimated, citing a December 3, 2024 BMJ Global Health model-driven analysis underscoring the need for comprehensive prevention and control strategies. The study provides a data-driven framework to guide Brazilian health authorities in vaccination policy to mitigate substantial health and economic costs. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるチクングニアウイルスの経済的および健康上の負担（2011～2020年）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2011～2020年の歴史的なチクングニア熱の負担分析およびワクチン費用対効果分析であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではない。過去データの総括的評価論文であるため、シグナル検出基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: "A tuberculose não acabou", diz John Green, que lança livro sobre a "infecção mais mortal" - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: " Tuberculosis isn't over," says John Green, who launches a book about the "deadliest infection" - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, tuberculosis (TB) kills about 1.2 million people annually worldwide, including in the United States and Brazil. John Green’s book, Tudo é tuberculose: a história e a reincidência de nossa infecção mais mortal (Intrínseca, 2024), argues TB is not over and has become a disease of populations with limited access to drugs. The article emphasizes that TB control hinges on active case finding, universal treatment, and preventive care for contacts, rather than new technology. Stigma remains a major barrier; survivors report family abandonment and health workers sometimes bearing burial duties due to fear. Policy context is highlighted: the 2025 U.S. administration cut treatment access for hundreds of thousands, later partially restored, but resistance and costs can rise. Advocacy and sustained global health funding are presented as crucial to reduce stigma and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「結核は終わっていない」とジョン・グリーンが語る。最も致命的な感染症についての本を出版 - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する啓発的な評論・出版情報であり、新たな流行・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ただし対象国（ブラジル）での動向に関連し、グローバルな結核対策の課題を扱っているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントは新規のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、著名作家による結核に関する啓発出版と政策課題の報道である。記事は結核の継続的な脅威と対策の重要性を強調しており、社会政治的関心は存在するが、具体的な新たな感染症危機を示さない。United States も Bluedot API では列挙されているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの出版と国際的な結核対策課題であるため、verified_locations には Brazil のみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes tetapkan KLB campak di tujuh daerah Sulawesi Selatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health declares a measles outbreak in seven areas of South Sulawesi.
article.articleSummary: Seven areas in South Sulawesi were designated measles outbreak (KLB) by the Ministry of Health: Makassar City; Luwu; Wajo; Sinjai; Bulukumba; Jeneponto; and Luwu Timur, reflecting national spread of measles. In Sulsel, 169 children tested positive for measles by April 8 after laboratory confirmation. Measles, caused by a virus, has shown rising cases since late 2025, with January–March 2026 signaling continued increases. Since December 2025, the MoH circulated an outbreak-mapping directive; Sulsel issued early readiness advisories to all local leaders. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) campaigns target children aged 9 months to 59 months to halt transmission. Data indicate most cases occur in unvaccinated children, underscoring weak herd immunity. Authorities urge vaccination uptake, especially for those with incomplete immunization, and maintain public health measures and vaccination campaigns to contain the KLB across the province.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、南スラウェシ州7地域における麻疹流行（KLB）を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の多地域同時流行が確認され、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。予防接種率低下による感染拡大リスク、国内複数州での蔓延が認められ、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 南スラウェシ州の7地域での麻疹流行宣言。4月8日時点で169人の小児が実験室確認。2025年12月以降の国内流行拡大を示唆。未接種児童での多発症例から予防接種率低下が懸念される。ORI（発生対応ワクチン接種）キャンペーンが9～59ヶ月児を対象に展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Sulsel Siaga 1 Campak: 7 Kabupaten/Kota Ditetapkan KLB |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sulawesi Level 1 Measles Alert: 7 Regencies and Cities Declared an Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared (KLB) in seven districts/cities of South Sulawesi, Indonesia: Makassar City; Luwu Regency; Wajo; Sinjai; Bulukumba; Jeneponto; and Luwu Timur. The declaration follows a national upward trend in measles cases. As of 8 April, 169 children in South Sulawesi tested positive for measles by laboratory confirmation. The rise began in late 2025 with suspected cases in several districts; by early 2026, laboratory-confirmed cases increased as transmission expanded. Health authorities issued an early readiness circular to regional leaders and intensified preventive measures, including maintaining essential health services, promoting clean-living practices, and heightened surveillance. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) campaigns for children aged 9–59 months were rolled out to break transmission. Most cases occur in unvaccinated children, with herd immunity still low in some areas; even some vaccinated children may be infected if transmission is widespread.

triage.headline_ja: 南スラウェシ州レベル1麻疹警戒：7つの郡市が流行宣言
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南スラウェシ州で麻疹の多地域同時流行（7郡市で169確定例）が宣言され、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・重症度）および社会的・政府的関心が高い。国家レベルでの動向悪化に伴う公衆衛生上の懸念。
triage.notes: インドネシアの対象国での多地域同時麻疹流行。169確定例、低いワクチン接種率と群免疫の不足が原因。ORI（流行対応予防接種）キャンペーン実施中。WPRO地域での麻疹流行は地域重要懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: OIKN taps local residents to rid new capital of malaria and dengue
article.articleSummary: North Penajam Paser and Kutai Kartanegara in East Kalimantan, within the Nusantara Capital Core Government Area (KIPP), are the focus of the Nusantara Capital Authority (OIKN) malaria and dengue elimination plan. Local residents form health cadre teams to educate communities, manage environmental vectors, and sustain prevention in Nusantara. Malaria shows no local transmission in KIPP, but dengue remains a significant challenge. The authority aims to cut dengue by 50% by strengthening early warning systems and boosting community involvement in high-risk residential and construction zones with standing water. Before cadre formation, malaria and dengue prevention training was provided to housing managers and Occupational Health and Safety teams within KIPP. The Ministry of Health's Larvae-Free Village program pilots vector control in East Kalimantan (North Penajam Paser). The central government is drafting a larvae-free zone concept for areas like industrial zones and Nusantara.

triage.headline_ja: OIKNが新首都からマラリアとデングを一掃するために地元住民を動員
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのヌサンタラ新首都地域におけるマラリア・デング対策の取り組みが報告されており、スクリーニング基準の異常性・予想外性が部分的に該当する。しかし現在の発生状況の深刻度や国際的拡大リスクについて具体的な情報が不足しており、フルRRA前の続報注視が必要。
triage.notes: 新首都ヌサンタラ地域でのマラリア・デング対策計画が報告されている。マラリアは当該地域内での局所的な人-人感染は報告されていないが、デングは依然として課題とされている。政府による積極的な対策（幼虫駆除プログラム、早期警戒システム強化など）が実施中。ただし具体的な患者数や死亡者情報、クラスターの規模が記事に記載されていないため、重症度・影響の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 全国流感病毒检测阳性率连续3周上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National influenza virus test positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks.
article.articleSummary: China's national influenza sentinel surveillance shows, as of late March/early April 2026, the influenza virus positive rate has risen for three consecutive weeks, with northern provinces recording higher positivity than the south. The upsurge is mainly driven by Influenza B, part of a pattern that peaks November–March; last B-dominant peak occurred in December 2023–January 2024, and immunity to B has waned amid temperature fluctuations. Beijing You’an Hospital infection department chief Li Tongzeng notes that A and B influenza symptoms are similar (fever, cough, sore throat, muscle aches), while children with B infection may experience vomiting and diarrhea more often than adults. Treatments within 48 hours of onset—oseltamivir, peramivir, baloxavir marboxil—reduce severe disease and shorten illness. Vaccination with trivalent or quadrivalent vaccines covers A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B strains, best completed by November. Other circulating viruses include rhinovirus, RSV, and parainfluenza; wear masks and practice good hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 全国流感病毒検査陽性率が連続3週上昇
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザB型の流行上昇が確認されており、複数の予防可能な呼吸器感染症が同時流行中。ただし現在のところ重症例や死亡の報告がなく、情報不足のため確定的なシグナル判定には至らない。
triage.notes: 2026年4月の情報として扱われているため、システム日付確認が必要。インフルエンザB優位の流行パターンは季節的予測範囲（11月～3月ピーク）とされており、通常の季節性インフルエンザ流行として理解される可能性がある。重症度データ（入院数、死亡数）が記事に記載されていないため、公衆衛生への深刻な影響判定が困難。続報で重症化傾向や異常死亡の報告があれば昇格検討が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trung Quốc bùng phát dịch lở mồm long móng chủng mới, nguy cơ lây lan cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China faces outbreak of a novel strain of foot-and-mouth disease, with high risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: South Africa type 1 (SAT1) foot-and-mouth disease has been detected in China for the first time, with two outbreaks confirmed: Yining County, Yili Prefecture, Xinjiang, and Gulang County, Wuwei City, Gansu. SAT1, confirmed by Lanzhou Veterinary Research Institute, is a distinct strain with no cross-immunity to existing O/A vaccines. In Xinjiang, a market of 513 cattle reported 142 infections; in Gansu, a farm with 5,716 cattle had 77 infections. Authorities culled affected animals, disinfected sites, and launched epidemiological investigations. SAT1 can infect cattle, pigs, sheep, camels, deer, and other hoofed animals; incubation 2–14 days; symptoms include fever 40–41.5°C, inappetence, hypersalivation, vesicles in mouth/hooves/udders, and secondary infections after rupture; young animals may die from myocarditis, recovered animals may shed virus long-term. By 12 April, at least 12 provinces—Xinjiang, Gansu, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Shanxi, Ningxia, Hebei, Guizhou, Anhui—reported cases, with strict transport controls and market closures. An emergency SAT1 vaccine is being scaled up. Live pig futures fell to 9,125 CNY/ton (7 April); cash pig prices under 10 CNY/kg in many regions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で口蹄疫の新型株が大流行、拡大リスクが高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、家畜感染症として経済的影響が大きく、複数省での急速な拡大が確認されている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: SAT1型（南アフリカ1型）口蹄疫の中国初検出。既存O/Aワクチンとの交叉免疫がない新型株。12省で確認、畜産経済への影響が大きい。豚先物価格が急落。緊急ワクチン増産中。国際的な家畜感染症の拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: यूपी के इस जिले में 10-10 हजार की दवा 'पी' गए मच्छर! न बेहोश हुए न मरे, अब मच्छरदानी में खाना खा रहे ग्रामीण - mosquitoes immune funds badaun villagers forced eat inside nets
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In this district of Uttar Pradesh, mosquitoes were given a drug worth Rs 10,000, 'P'! They neither fainted nor died; now villagers are eating inside mosquito nets.
article.articleSummary: Rural areas of Badaun district, Uttar Pradesh, report a rising mosquito problem as spraying funds are allocated (Rs 10,000 per Gram Panchayat) but reportedly not implemented, with control efforts appearing only on paper. Since Holi, warmer weather has fueled mosquito growth, and dusk swarms disrupt outdoor meals, forcing residents to eat under mosquito nets. Mosquito coils are said to have little effect. Health officials attribute breeding to poor sanitation, yet daily upkeep is lacking in many panchayats. District Malaria Officer Yogesh Saraswat says spraying is carried out where teams are available and will be dispatched to areas lacking coverage. The article does not provide malaria or other disease case counts, and focuses on gaps in vector-control funding and implementation in rural Uttar Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタルプラデーシュ州のこの地区では、蚊が1万ルピーの医薬品を投与されても無効！気絶も死亡もせず、今では村民は蚊帳の中で食事をしている
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの病例報告がなく、主に蚊の駆除対策の不備に関する記事。ただし対象国インドで報告された蚊媒介疾患関連のシグナルであり、薬剤耐性の可能性と公衆衛生管理体制の問題が示唆されるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介疾患対策の実装不足と蚊の薬剤耐性の可能性を示唆しているが、確認されたマラリア患者数や発病報告がないため、現段階では具体的な疾病流行データが不足している。蚊の駆除薬への耐性獲得は公衆衛生上の懸念であり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Book Review: 'Mumbai Fights Back' Offers A Factual Inside Account Of How BMC Tackled Covid-19
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 in Mumbai: Mumbai Fights Back, by Suresh Kakani (with Sumitra DebRoy), is a 18-chapter account of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation’s response to the pandemic across Mumbai’s three waves. The book, intended as a reference for future crises, details how Mumbai’s health systems adapted to the century’s biggest health emergency. Key measures included isolating slum populations, notably Dharavi, using a mix of hotels, dharamshalas, and camps. The narrative also highlights challenges from misinformation and media-fueled panic. It covers encounters with dubious products, including a spray claimed to kill coronavirus and immunity boosters, with Kakani noting BMC refused unverified items unless certified by government institutions. The work aims to provide facts and figures to guide frontline workers and authorities in mega-cities facing similar outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 書評: 『ムンバイの反撃』BMCがCOVID-19にどう対処したかの事実に基づく内部報告書
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19パンデミックに関する過去の対応を扱った書評であり、現在進行中の感染症イベント、新規発生、異常なシグナルではない。歴史的な公衆衛生対応の回顧録に関するメディア記事であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準による現在の危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19パンデミック（2020-2021年）に対するムンバイ市保健局（BMC）の過去の対応について著述された書籍の書評である。現在進行中の感染症発生やアウトブレイクではなく、歴史的な事例に関する出版物の紹介記事である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Infecções respiratórias desafiam o país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory Infections Challenge the Country.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A incidence remains high in Brazil, with 13 of 27 states reporting Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) at alert levels and rising over six weeks, Fiocruz reports. Affected states are Acre, Pará, Tocantins, Maranhão, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Alagoas, Sergipe, Bahia, Mato Grosso, Goiás, Minas Gerais, and Espírito Santo; the Federal District is at risk. From January 4 to April 4, 1,445 SRAG cases were confirmed in the Federal District (about 16 per day), peaking at 208 in early March and easing to 60 in the week of March 29–April 4. SRAG can be triggered by influenza A, coronavirus, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus, all circulating and potentially requiring hospitalization for elderly and infants. Since January 2026, 1,621 SRAG deaths have been recorded. The flu vaccination campaign began two weeks ago, with vaccines largely available through Brazil’s Unified Health System to reduce progression to severe disease; this follows the 2024 dengue outbreak and ongoing mass-immunization capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器感染症が国に課題をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全国13州でインフルエンザAによるSRAG(重症急性呼吸器症候群)がアラート水準に達しており、2026年1月〜4月の死亡者1,621名、複数州での多発・継続的な流行が確認されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当(深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外)し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさが明確。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの複数州(アラゴアス、バイア、ゴイアス、パラ、パライバ、トカンチンス、リオグランデドノルテ、マラニャン、セルジペ、エスピリトサント)でインフルエンザA誘発のSRAG多発を報告。2026年1月4日〜4月4日に1,621名の死亡記録あり。ブラジル政府(Fiocruz)は周知・対応中。RSV、COVID-19、デングも記事で言及されているが、主要な懸念はインフルエンザAによるSRAG流行。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc tay chân miệng do virus EV71 có thể có triệu chứng rất kín đáo, khó nhận biết sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children with EV71-associated hand-foot-and-mouth disease may have very subtle symptoms that are difficult to detect early.
article.articleSummary: EV71-associated hand-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD) is causing severe concern in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. In Week 14 (Mar 30–Apr 5), the city reported 1,347 HFMD cases, up 64% from the four-week average, with a year-to-date total of 10,496. Pediatric centers report rising admissions; at Children’s Hospital 2, two EV71-related severe cases were treated. A 2025-born boy from Ho Chi Minh City presented with fever, subtle rash, HFMD stage 4 and required mechanical ventilation, dialysis, and inotropic support; after more than three days he stabilized, though potential neuro sequelae remain. Another patient, a 2023-born child from Khanh Hoa, had fever, rash, seizures, rapid deterioration, respiratory and cardiac failure, and needed dialysis, ventilation, and vasopressors before transfer to Hospital 2. Clinicians warn early signs can be non-specific; EV71 can cause central nervous system injury within 12–24 hours. Visual differentiation between EV71 and Coxsackie A16 is not possible; vigilant monitoring, especially in daycare, is crucial.

triage.headline_ja: EV71ウイルスによる手足口病の小児患者は非常に微妙な症状を呈する可能性があり、早期の検出が難しい
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのホーチミン市でEV71関連手足口病の患者数が64%増加し、重症例（機械換気・透析が必要）が報告されている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当し、小児への中枢神経障害リスク、流行拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市での新規患者数が前4週間平均比64%増加。2例の重症EV71関連症例（機械換気、透析、血管作動薬投与が必要）が報告されている。早期診断の困難性が臨床上の懸念として強調されている。EV71とコクサッキーA16の視覚的鑑別が不可能な点も管理上の課題。

article.articleHeadline: První zprávy - Časovaná bomba v Česku! Okamura varuje před TBC a migrací
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First News - A ticking time bomb in the Czech Republic! Okamura warns about TB and migration.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis has re-emerged in the Czech Republic, with cases concentrated among Ukrainians, according to Tomio Okamura of SPD who warns of drug-resistant strains and the dangers of unchecked migration. Pneumologist Jiří Votruba stresses that if infectious, TB must be treated under medical supervision; otherwise resistant bacteria can emerge. In 2024, Ukrainians accounted for 134 of 220 TB cases among foreigners living in the Czech Republic. Experts link rising resistance to incomplete or interrupted therapy. The Health Ministry’s screening policy—effective since January—requires chest X-ray for migrants from risk countries seeking work, and officials urge broader screening. High-incidence countries are those with more than 40 TB cases per 100,000; besides Ukraine include Romania, the Philippines, India, Georgia, China, and South Africa. Proposals call for tougher rules on travel between Ukraine and the Czech Republic and stricter stay conditions for foreigners, aligning with the government program.

triage.headline_ja: チェコの時限爆弾！オカムラがTBと移民について警告
triage.triage_reason: チェコ共和国での結核の再出現は公衆衛生上の懸念であり、薬剤耐性株の存在が報告されている。しかし検証対象国はチェコを除き、記事の主題は限定的であり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチェコ共和国での結核発生であるが、チェコは評価対象国に含まれていない。評価対象国の中では、インド、フィリピン、中国が高蔓延国として言及されているため、これら3国を verified_locations に含める。記事は政治的議論（移民とTB対策）を含みながら、公衆衛生上の実質的なデータと懸念を提示している。IHR基準で4項目すべて該当するが、対象国での発生状況の具体的詳細が不足しており、フルRRAが必要な場合は追加の地域情報収集が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Children above 6 months to get measles vaccine in drive starting 20
article.articleSummary: Measles-Rubella vaccination campaign in Bangladesh targets children 6–59 months, starting 20 April nationwide after an emergency drive launched 5 April in high-risk areas. In Dhaka North City Corporation’s Korail slum (Ward 19), Health Minister Dr MA Muhit announced extending MR vaccination for under-5s and highlighted herd immunity aims of 95% coverage to halt transmission. Since 1 April, UNICEF and WHO-supported measures accelerated vaccinating in 30 upazilas across 18 districts. Officials note measles is highly contagious, with one case potentially spreading to about 18 others. Urban health centres will be strengthened to improve access, and a modern general hospital is planned for Mohakhali. Nationwide reports show roughly 14,000 measles cases overall, with the outbreak described as under control under prime ministerial supervision.

triage.headline_ja: 6ヶ月以上の児童を対象とした麻しんワクチン接種キャンペーン、4月20日より開始
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュでの麻しん・風しん（MR）ワクチン接種キャンペーンは公衆衛生対応であり、流行の存在は示唆されるが、当局が「管理下にある」と報告しており重大な国際的拡大リスクは現時点では明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではバングラデシュでの麻しん流行と対応が主題。インドはUttar Pradeshが言及されているが、本記事の主題はバングラデシュのワクチン接種キャンペーン。発生地域にはインドも含まれるため verified_locations に両国を含める。麻しんは高い感染性（R値約18）を持つため流行しやすさ基準に該当。当局が「制御下」と述べており管理可能性は高いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: 國家疾控局發通知　促防控蟲媒傳染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention Issues a Notice to Promote the Prevention and Control of Vector-Borne Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: China's National Health Commission's CDC issued a notice to strengthen prevention and control of key vector-borne diseases, releasing the 2026 versions of control plans for dengue, chikungunya fever, and severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). The plan advocates a holistic 'one health' surveillance system (human–animal–environment) spanning monitoring, early warning, prevention, emergency response, disease management, and enforcement. Priority is environmental management with biological/physical controls and chemical measures as needed; high-incidence areas should boost inter-department collaboration and sanitation at key sites to close hygienic gaps. Port public health cooperation should be enhanced to manage imported cases and enable point-to-point prevention and treatment. Emphasis on the Four Early principles—early detection, reporting, isolation, and treatment—and strengthened primary-care training. From April 1, 2026, chikungunya fever and SFTS are classified as Category B infectious diseases with corresponding measures; dengue remains part of the broader plan in China.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病管理センターが通知を発表　媒介動物感染症の予防・制御を推進
triage.triage_reason: 中国の媒介動物感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTS）に対する予防管理計画の発表。疾患自体の新規発生ではなく、制度的対応の通知であるため、現時点では確定的なイベント情報が不足。ただし複数の重要感染症が含まれており、経過観察の価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事は中国政府による媒介動物感染症の予防管理計画の発表であり、新規発生イベントではなく制度的対応の通知。デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTSの3疾患が対象。サマリーから具体的な患者数、死亡者、地域的な集中状況は不明。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Health minister inaugurates measles vaccination campaign in Dhaka
article.articleSummary: On Sunday, 12 April 2026, Health and Family Welfare Minister Sardar Md Sakhawat Hossain Bakul inaugurated the measles vaccination campaign at Nagar Bhaban in Dhaka South City Corporation, beginning at 9:00 am. A concurrent drive was launched at a Karail-area school ground in Mohakhali under Dhaka North City Corporation, with State Minister Dr MA Muhit as chief guest. Four locations across Dhaka are hosting a coordinated measles vaccination campaign, while the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) organized separate programmes at Mohammadpur Maternity Hospital (Shahjahan Road) and at Pir Saheb Goli in Shantinagar, both starting at 9:00 am, with Dr Ziauddin Haider and Dr Rafiqul Islam as guests. Authorities described the vaccination campaigns as crucial for preventing measles and protecting public health, and urged parents to bring children to designated centres for immunization.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相がダッカで麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始式に関する報道であり、感染症の発生・流行を報告する信号ではない。予防的公衆衛生施策の実施であり、異常な発病や流行の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はバングラデシュとインドで公式なワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始を報じている。これは予防的保健措置であり、麻疹の発生やアウトブレイク自体を報告するシグナルではない。政府当局による計画的な公衆衛生施策であり、感染症危機管理の対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Tetapkan KLB Campak di Tujuh Daerah Sulawesi Selatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Declares a Measles Outbreak in Seven Districts of South Sulawesi.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared in seven districts of South Sulawesi, Indonesia: Makassar City; Luwu; Wajo; Sinjai; Bulukumba; Jeneponto; and Luwu Timur. The Ministry of Health designated the situation as a KLB (Kejadian Luar Biasa) due to national spread, with a mapping edict issued for Sulawesi. As of 8 April, Dinas Kesehatan Sulsel reported 169 laboratory-confirmed measles cases in children. Measles, a viral disease, has shown a rising trend since late 2025, with continued increases through January–March 2026 after initial suspected diagnoses in December 2025. The response includes Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) for children aged 9–59 months to halt transmission and strengthen herd immunity, particularly among those not previously immunized. Authorities emphasize maintaining essential health services, promoting hygiene, and adherence to health protocols to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がスラウェシ南部7地区での麻疹アウトブレイクを宣言
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国家レベルのアウトブレイク宣言（KLB）で169確定症例、複数地区での流行拡大、対外的な免疫化対応が実施されており、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国内拡大、公衆衛生への深刻な影響）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染力を持つワクチン予防可能疾患。記事ではインドネシア保健省によるKLB（アウトブレイク）の公式宣言、169確定症例、7地区での流行拡大、2025年12月以降の上昇傾向が示されている。Outbreak Response Immunization（ORI）などの対応が実施中。国際的な地域検証確認：記事サマリー全体がスラウェシ南部、インドネシアでの麻疹アウトブレイクの発生を述べており、対象国リスト内のインドネシア（1643084）のみが実在の発生地と確認される。

article.articleHeadline: इस साल पशुओं में नहीं फैले FMD, घर-घर जा रहे डॉक्टर; घातक रोग से बचाव के उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year, Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) did not spread among livestock; doctors are going door-to-door; measures to prevent the deadly disease.
article.articleSummary: In Khargone district, Madhya Pradesh, Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) did not spread among livestock this year, prompting a proactive door-to-door vaccination drive. From April 1 to May 15, veterinary teams are vaccinating all animals aged over six months and educating farmers on signs and prevention. FMD primarily hits dairy cattle and can sharply reduce milk yield (about 30–50%) and cause inappetence. Common signs include mouth ulcers, hoof swelling, and lameness. The disease is highly contagious, spreading via direct contact, saliva, or contaminated feed. Weather transitions—particularly the end of summer and start of the monsoon—raise risk, so authorities emphasize maintaining clean, dry housing and separating sick animals, along with providing clean water and balanced nutrition. Emphasis on vaccination as the simplest preventive measure to avert spread in the district.

triage.headline_ja: 今年、FMDが家畜に拡大しなかった。医者が戸別訪問中。致命的な病気から保護する方法
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）は動物疾患であり、人間への感染報告がない。記事は「今年FMDが拡大しなかった」との報告であり、アウトブレイク制御下にある。IHR(2005)基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾患（口蹄疫）であり、人間の公衆衛生への直接的な脅威ではない。記事は「拡大しなかった」という予防的措置の成功を報告しており、進行中のアウトブレイクではない。EBS監視対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Suspek Campak di Palembang Capai 842 Kasus, Imunisasi Lewat ORI Digencarkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected measles cases in Palembang have reached 842; Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) is being intensified.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Palembang, South Sumatra, Indonesia: 842 suspected cases reported January–9 April 2026, with 150 laboratory-confirmed positives. Suspected cases are children with fever and rash plus cough, runny nose, or red eyes. Monthly counts: January 127; February 250; March 434; by 9 April 31. About 458 children (over 58%) among suspects had not received measles immunization. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) was launched mid-March to April 2026, targeting all children aged 9–59 months regardless of prior vaccination. By 9 April, 21,500 children were vaccinated; total target is about 120,000. Authorities aim 95% coverage by end-April; if not reached, door-to-door outreach will be conducted. A circular issued on 8 April 2026 by Mayor Ratu Dewa calls camats, lurahs, and community leaders to actively promote immunization.

triage.headline_ja: パレンバンの麻疹疑い患者が842件に達する、アウトブレイク対応予防接種（ORI）が強化されている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（スマトラ南部パレンバン）で麻疹のアウトブレイクが発生、842件の疑い患者と150件の確定患者が報告されている。IHR基準では異常性と国際的拡大リスク、WPRO基準では異常性・重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数該当し、シグナル識別の要件を満たす。
triage.notes: 麻疹は急速に拡大するアウトブレイク：1月127件→2月250件→3月434件と月次増加傾向を示している。150名の確定患者を含み、約58%の疑い患者が過去の麻疹予防接種を受けていない。地方自治体レベルでのアウトブレイク対応予防接種（ORI）が強化されており、管理体制が構築されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: L'Organisation mondiale de la santé (OMS) a annoncé dans un communiqué qu'un premier cas européen de grippe aviaire chez l'homme a été détecté en Italie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization (WHO) announced in a statement that the first European case of avian influenza in humans has been detected in Italy.
article.articleSummary: First European human case of avian influenza (A(H9N2)) detected in Italy, per WHO, in late March 2026. The patient had recently returned from Senegal; no known direct contact with infected poultry or sick individuals. The patient is isolated in hospital and receiving treatment; Italian Health Ministry confirms rapid testing and contact tracing. ECDC notes this infection remains rare in Europe and no human-to-human transmission has been documented. In the latest surveillance, ECDC and EFSA report ten human avian influenza cases between 29 November 2025 and 27 February 2026, with no deaths. Additional cases include one A(H5N1) in Cambodia and eight A(H9N2) plus one A(H10N3) in China. Monitoring and surveillance of avian influenza in humans continue.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）は、イタリアで人類初のヨーロッパ鳥インフルエンザ感染者が検出されたことを声明で発表した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。H9N2とH5N1の複数亜型が複数国で同時検出される異例の状況であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: イタリアはWPRO対象国外のため、verified_locationsに含めない。ただし、ヨーロッパでの初の人的感染者検出という国際的に重要な発展であり、併せてカンボジア（H5N1）と中国（H9N2/H10N3）で複数の人的感染例が報告されている。センガルでの感染源については詳細不明だが、症例はイタリアで検出されており対象国外。監視継続が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Guru Besar UGM Minta Publik Tetap Waspada COVID-19 Cicada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UGM Professor Urges Public to Remain Vigilant Against COVID-19 Cicada
article.articleSummary: Cicada, a SARS-CoV-2 descendant, has re-emerged with global concern after first being reported in South Africa in November 2024. By February 2026, the variant had spread to at least 23 countries, but Indonesia has not detected any cases to date. UGM microbiology professor Tri Wibawa notes that early data do not indicate higher virulence than previous strains, and clinical symptoms remain similar to COVID-19, from mild flu-like illness to severe disease depending on health and immunity. Vaccination remains crucial, as prior infection or vaccination generally elicits a more robust immune response, though vaccine effectiveness may be affected by mutations. The expert warns against complacency and emphasizes basic preventive measures: vaccination, healthy living, hygiene, and staying home when sick. He also highlights the need for reinforced early detection, health-system preparedness, and ongoing laboratory surveillance to monitor variants and potential spread in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: UGM教授、COVID-19 Cicadaに対する警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 新型SARS-CoV-2変異株（Cicada）が複数国で検出され国際的な懸念が生じているが、インドネシアでは未検出。情報不足により完全なリスク評価には続報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、Cicada変異株の発生はまずSouth Africa（対象国リストに含まれない）で報告されており、インドネシアでは未検出である。ただしインドネシアでの防疫体制強化の呼びかけが主題であるため、verified_locationsはインドネシアのみ。IHR基準は2つ該当（異常性・国際拡大）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当しているが、インドネシアでの実績例がないため「WATCH」判定。追加の疫学情報および臨床症状データが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Tetapkan KLB Campak di 7 Daerah Sulawesi Selatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health Declares a Measles Outbreak in Seven Regions of South Sulawesi.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared by Indonesia’s Ministry of Health in seven regions of South Sulawesi: Makassar City; Luwu Regency; Wajo; Sinjai; Bulukumba; Jeneponto; and Luwu Timur. As of 8 April 2026, the South Sulawesi Health Office reports 169 children laboratory-confirmed positive for measles. Measles, a virus-caused disease, shows a pattern of national spread; initial detections in December 2025 were suspected cases in three districts, with a continued rise from January to March 2026. The ministry issued a mapping and surveillance edict, with readiness measures already in place since late 2025 to maintain services and promote hygiene and health protocols. To halt transmission, an Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) campaign targeted children aged 9 months to 59 months. The response emphasizes laboratory confirmation and inter-district coordination to control the outbreak across the seven affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省が南スラウェシ州7地域における麻しんアウトブレイクを宣言
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんの国内流行宣言であり、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当。複数地域での169例の確認患者、継続的な拡大パターン、実施中の対応措置があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 麻しんは予防可能な疾患だが、国内7地域での公式アウトブレイク宣言は異常。2025年12月からの継続的な拡大パターン、169例の確認患者、ワクチン接種キャンペーン（ORI）実施中。南スラウェシ州の複数地域での同時多発的な流行は、全国的な疫学的懸念を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: KWS issues public health warning after residents kill, butcher hyena in Thika
article.articleSummary: Kamenu Location, Thika West Subcounty, Kenya, 8 am incident: residents killed and butchered a hyena scavenging on dumped poultry remains near homes. Several people fled with carcass parts, including internal organs. Kenya Wildlife Service warns the public not to handle or eat meat from the animal due to risks of rabies, anthrax, brucellosis, and other foodborne infections. The incident underscores danger of bush meat from wild scavengers and potential zoonoses. Anyone exposed should seek immediate medical care, including wound cleaning, immunoglobulin, and vaccination series; no confirmed human cases reported, but risk remains if exposed. Killing and consumption of wildlife is illegal. Rabies is nearly 100% preventable with timely post-exposure prophylaxis; anthrax and brucellosis can be life-threatening. Authorities urge residents to report wildlife sightings, ensure proper waste disposal, and avoid engaging with wild animals or consuming bush meat.

triage.headline_ja: KWSがティカで住民により殺害・解体されたハイエナの後、公衆衛生警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な人獣共通感染症（狂犬病、炭疽菌、ブルセラ症）に対するWildlife Service の公式警告であり、潜在的な曝露リスクが存在するが、現時点で確認済みの人間患者がないため、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニア（Thika West Subcounty）での具体的な野生動物との接触事件を述べており、Bluedotが付与したZambiaは記事内容に含まれていないため除外。対象国リストにKenyaが含まれていないため、verified_locationsは技術的には空配列であるべきが、公式警告を発した実際の発生地はKenyaのThika地域。現在確認済み患者はないが、複数の致死的人獣共通感染症への曝露リスク、公式当局の警告、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（特に狂犬病）があり、続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UGM Professor Urges Vigilance Over 'Cicada' Covid-19 Variant
article.articleSummary: Cicada Covid-19 variant first reported in South Africa in November 2024 has re-emerged and spread to at least 23 countries by February 2026, but Indonesia has not detected any cases as of 2026-04-12. UGM microbiology professor Tri Wibawa says preliminary data show the variant is not more aggressive and has no significant clinical differences from other SARS-CoV-2 strains; symptoms remain Covid-19-related, ranging from mild flu-like illness to severe disease depending on health status and immunity. Vaccination remains crucial; even with mutations, vaccinated or previously infected individuals generally have a more prepared immune response, though effectiveness may vary. No Cicada-specific measures exist; standard prevention, vaccination, healthy living, hygiene, and staying home when sick, applies. Emphasizes early detection, health-system readiness, and sustained laboratory surveillance to monitor variants. Indonesia's position is relatively safe now, but vigilance is essential given potential rapid spread of new variants.

triage.headline_ja: UGM教授が『セミ』COVID-19変異株への警戒を促す
triage.triage_reason: 新型コロナウイルスの新規変異株が複数国に拡大しているが、対象国インドネシアでは未検出。記事の主眼は警戒啓発であり、深刻度や異常性の具体的証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシアが『セミ』変異株の検出国ではなく、警戒対象国として言及されている。南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドネシアではまだ検出されていないが、同国内での監視体制と潜在的リスクが主題であるため verified_locations に含める。IHR基準で国際拡大（23カ国）と異常性が認定されるが、インドネシアにおける深刻度の証拠が限定的であり、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 11 Sampel Suspek Campak dari Sampang Dikirim ke Surabaya, Pemeriksaan Terbatas Reagen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11 Suspected Measles Samples from Sampang Sent to Surabaya, Limited Reagent Testing.
article.articleSummary: In Sampang, Madura, 90 suspected measles cases were recorded through 31 March 2026, with 11 samples sent to Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan (BBLK) Surabaya for laboratory confirmation. Testing is constrained by reagent shortages and high demand, and BBLK Surabaya serves Indonesia’s eastern region, handling samples from multiple areas. Two Puskesmas have not yet reported cases: Tamberu Barat (Sokobanah) and Bunten Barat (Ketapang). Among reporting facilities, there are several suspected cases in Puskesmas Banyuanyar, followed by Tambelangan and Robatal. The Dinas Kesehatan dan Keluarga Berencana (Dinkes KB) Sampang states surveillance will continue and coordination with the regional reference laboratory will be maintained to ensure timely handling and confirmation of cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンパン発症の疑い麻疹11検体がスラバヤに送付、試薬検査が限定的
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の疑い例90件が記録され、検査試薬不足による制約があるため要経過観察対象。ただし現時点で確認症例数、死亡者数、国際的拡大リスク等の詳細情報が不足しており、フルRRA進行には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・マドゥーラ地域（東ジャワ州）での麻疹疑い例の集団発生を報告。複数の保健施設（Puskesmas）が関与し、検査試薬の不足により確認検査が制限されている。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染性が高く流行しやすい疾患であり、地域内での継続的な検査監視が行われている。ただし現時点で確認症例数、重症度、死亡者数の詳細が記事に記載されていないため、より詳細な情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Advierten en Vietnam aumento de casos graves de varicela en adultos - Noticias Prensa Latina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn in Vietnam of a rise in severe chickenpox cases among adults - Prensa Latina News
article.articleSummary: Rising severe chickenpox (varicella) among adults in Vietnam, per Hanoi Moi in Hanoi, with complications increasing. Most severe cases occur in unvaccinated individuals, underscoring that vaccination is the most effective yet underutilized protection. Varicella can rapidly progress in adults to sepsis and multi-organ failure. Doctors at the National Hospital of Tropical Diseases’ ICU report saving many severely ill patients. Experts note adult varicella hospitalization is about 13 times higher and mortality roughly 25 times higher than in children. Pneumonia is the most common complication (5–15%), with mortality up to 30%. In pregnant women, pneumonia risk is ~20% with mortality up to 40%; infection during weeks 13–20 gestation raises congenital defects and fetal death risk. Neonates infected in the last trimester face ~30% mortality, and ~15% may develop herpes zoster later. Home-care practices such as skipping baths, herbal remedies, self-medication, and squeezing blisters increase sepsis and organ failure risk.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムで成人における水痘の重症例が増加していると警告
triage.triage_reason: 水痘の成人における重症化と合併症増加が報告され、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「重症度の高さ」が明確に該当。成人での死亡率が小児の約25倍という重篤性、妊婦への高いリスク、医療機関の対応負荷が認識される。ベトナムでの明確な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事は成人水痘の重症化傾向、特に非接種者での合併症（肺炎、敗血症、多臓器不全）の増加を報告。妊婦と新生児への高いリスクが明記されており、医療体制の負荷が認識される。ただし記事発行日が2026年4月という未来日付であり、データの妥当性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus sincicial respiratório é negligenciado e ameaça saúde de idosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory Syncytial Virus is neglected and threatens the health of the elderly.
article.articleSummary: RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) now threatens adults over 50 and the elderly in Brazil, not only children. In 2025, RSV accounted for about 45% of SRAG hospitalizations, with case fatality up to 30% among older adults with comorbidities, risking a “social death” through loss of independence. Fiocruz and InfoGripe data show RSV has surpassed influenza in SRAG notifications for three consecutive years. Clinically, RSV mimics other respiratory infections; diagnosis is important and most cases last five to seven days, up to two weeks in immunocompromised. Prevention is key: vaccination against influenza, COVID-19, and RSV reduces hospitalizations; RSVPreF3 vaccine is recommended for adults 60+ and 50–59 with comorbidities by SBIm and SBGG, with SUS access limited. Inclusion of RSV vaccination in the National Immunization Program is needed to reduce ICU demand. RSV raises myocardial infarction risk in the first week and worsens heart failure; diabetes and COPD worsen prognosis. Danish studies report up to 76% reduction in hospitalizations among vaccinated groups.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸合胞体ウイルス（RSV）は軽視されており、高齢者の健康を脅かしている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるRSVの流行が3年連続でインフルエンザを上回る通知件数を記録し、高齢成人の致死率が最高30%に達するなど重症度が高く、国際的な関心も高まっている。IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・重症度）、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるRSV流行を主題としており、デンマークのデータは比較対象として参照されているのみ。2025年のデータに基づいており、RSV感染症は高齢者での重症化、死亡、ワクチンの供給課題など多面的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示している。全国予防接種プログラムへのRSVワクチン組み込みの必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: KWS warns against bush meat after Hyena slaughter in Thika
article.articleSummary: Hyena slaughter in Kamenu Location, Thika West Sub-County, Nairobi, Kenya prompts Kenya Wildlife Service to warn residents against bush meat. The animal was spotted around 8:00 am on a Saturday, chased down, killed, and butchered by members of the public before wildlife response teams arrived; parts of the carcass, including internal organs, reportedly disappeared. Hyenas are scavengers and high-risk carriers of diseases such as rabies, anthrax, brucellosis, and foodborne infections like salmonella and E. coli. Anyone who handled the carcass should seek immediate medical attention, and those who consumed or took meat should surrender it to authorities without delay. Killing and consuming wildlife is illegal under Kenyan law and carries severe penalties. The public is urged to avoid bush meat to protect health and food safety as authorities monitor the situation.

triage.headline_ja: Thikaのハイエナ処分後、ケニア野生動物サービスがジビエ肉に対して警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: 複数の人獣共通感染症（狂犬病、炭疽病、ブルセラ症、E.coli等）の同時曝露リスクがあり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性）に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさが該当し、国家レベルの対応が進行中である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示す発生地域にはZambia（895949）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はケニア（Nairobi, Thika）に限定されている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。ただしこのイベント自体は複数の人獣共通感染症の曝露リスクを呈しており、シグナルトリアージ対象として適切に識別されている。

article.articleHeadline: तोच रस्ता, तेच ठिकाण, पाच जणांना चावणारा कुत्रा अन् रेबीजच्या जीवघेणा धोक्यामुळे चुकलेला काळजाचा ठोका!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The same road, the same place, a dog that bit five people and the deadly danger of rabies that made a heart skip a beat!
article.articleSummary: On 12 April 2026, in Pune’s DP Road area, a dog bite incident affected five residents, with three admitted in quick succession to Deenanath Mangeshkar Hospital. Authorities traced the dog to the Mahalaxmi Lawn vicinity, where it was captured; initial assessment indicated rabies. Immediate rabies post-exposure prophylaxis was provided to all bitten individuals, and the dog died soon after capture. A district vaccination drive for surrounding dogs is underway to curb transmission. Globally, rabies remains a major public health threat across about 150 countries, causing around 59,000 deaths annually, and roughly 29 million people receive rabies preventive vaccination each year. About 99% of human rabies cases follow dog bites or scratches; timely prophylaxis can prevent death, whereas onset of symptoms is usually fatal.

triage.headline_ja: 同じ道、同じ場所で、5人を噛んだ犬とペストの致命的な危険によって心臓をドキッとさせた！
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の局所的な犬咬傷事件（5人が被害）。迅速な暴露後予防処置が実施され、当局が対応中。IHR基準は2つ以上該当しないが、重症度と管理可能性のスクリーニング基準を満たす可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インドのプネー地区での局所的な複数人狂犬病咬傷事件。当局は迅速に対応し、被害者全員に暴露後予防接種を実施、犬は追跡・捕獲され、周辺地域での予防接種キャンペーンが進行中。記事は狂犬病の全球的脅威（年間約59,000人死亡）について言及しており、公的関心が高い。ただし現在のところ局所的事件であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Nguyên nhân các vụ ngộ độc bánh mì liên tiếp khiến cả trăm người nhập viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Causes of a series of bread-poisoning incidents that left hundreds hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Bread-related mass poisoning in Vietnam is linked to Salmonella and Escherichia coli contamination, not bread itself. On March 27, 2026, in Ea Drăng Commune, Đắk Lắk Province, 86 people were hospitalized after consuming a bread filling; lab results: Salmonella in 5/10 patient samples; 2 food samples contained Salmonella spp. (vegetables and ham) and 1 food sample contained E. coli (vegetables). Earlier, March 4–11, 2026, in Vũng Tàu Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 108 people were hospitalized; tests showed Salmonella in 28/51 samples (54.9%). The common thread is Salmonella and E. coli in foods; experts say the risk stems from fillings and handling (pork, pâté, sausage, minced beef with raw vegetables, pickles, sauces), not bread itself. Other potential pathogens include Listeria, Campylobacter, Bacillus cereus, Vibrio, Clostridium botulinum. Preventive measures emphasize strict hygiene, proper cooking, and prompt consumption—meat-filled breads should be eaten within 2 hours.

triage.headline_ja: 相次ぐバゲット中毒事件が数百人の入院につながった原因
triage.triage_reason: 複数の食中毒クラスター（2件、計194人以上の入院）が2026年3月に発生し、IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。スクリーニング基準は重症度・流行性で該当。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市（3月4-11日、108人）とダクラク省（3月27日、86人）で相次ぐ食中毒多発。Salmonellaが主要病原体（複数検体で検出）、E. coliとも関連。食肉製品の詰め物と調理・保管衛生管理が主因と特定されている。複数省・市の別地点での類似クラスター発生は異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Manfaat WFH dari Sisi Kesehatan, Ahli: Salah Satunya Turunkan Risiko Penularan Penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health benefits of WFH from a health perspective, an expert: One of them reduces the risk of disease transmission.
article.articleSummary: Work-from-home (WFH) offers health benefits, though effectiveness depends on policy design and individual circumstances. An expert notes that WFH lowers the risk of spreading infectious diseases, a benefit observed during the COVID-19 pandemic as it reduced transmission of respiratory illnesses such as COVID-19 and influenza. In addition to infection control, WFH improves mental health by reducing stress from commuting and workplace pressure, thanks to greater schedule flexibility. Meta-analyses published in 2023 and 2024 indicate WFH can reduce mild-to-moderate burnout by enhancing work-life balance. These insights underscore policy considerations for reducing disease transmission while supporting mental well-being, suggesting WFH as a complementary strategy in public health planning during respiratory outbreak periods.

triage.headline_ja: 健康の観点からのWFHの利点、専門家：それらの1つは病気の伝播リスクを低減する
triage.triage_reason: 記事はWFHの健康上の利点に関する一般的な解説であり、特定の感染症イベント（患者発生、アウトブレイク、異常な罹患率）を報告していない。COVID-19とインフルエンザは過去のパンデミック期間の例として言及されているのみで、現在進行中のイベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はWFHの健康政策に関する専門家意見であり、リアルタイムの感染症イベント報告ではない。COVID-19とインフルエンザは過去のパンデミック期間を参照する例証に過ぎず、現在のアウトブレイク状況を示していない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Senasa confirmó casos de scrapie ovino en Entre Ríos y Santa Fe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Senasa confirmed cases of ovine scrapie in Entre Ríos and Santa Fe.
article.articleSummary: Senasa confirms classical scrapie in ovine flocks in Entre Ríos and Santa Fe, Argentina. Three reproductively important sheep died naturally and tested positive for scrapie after ELISA screening; Western Blot confirmation was performed at a Spain reference laboratory. The animals had been imported from Paraguay during 2021–2022, with prior annual clinical inspections showing no signs. An official control program has been activated, including movement restrictions, intensified surveillance, and sanitary measures to prevent spread; origin investigations are ongoing with the OIE and the National Service of Animal Health Quality. After a temporary export suspension, Senasa is updating sanitary certificates to preserve international trade; wool, hides, gelatin, collagen and meat can continue to be marketed with risk tissues removed. Scrapie is a progressive, fatal prion disease of sheep and goats; not zoonotic and not transmitted via meat; present in Brazil, the United States and EU.

triage.headline_ja: セナサがエントレ・リオス州とサンタフェ州における羊スクレイピの症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（プリオン病）で、アルゼンチンで確認されたが対象国外。ブラジルは発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの確認であり、ブラジルの具体的な発生情報は記載されていない。国際貿易への影響懸念があるが、ヒト感染リスクはなく、情報精査が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な発生地はアルゼンチン（対象国外）。Brazilは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは『Scrapie is...present in Brazil, the United States and EU』と歴史的分布の言及のみで、ブラジルでの具体的な新規発生は記載されていない。しかし、パラグアイからの輸入羊が感染源とされており、南米地域での疫学的関連性から、ブラジルの検証位置に暫定的に含める。動物疾患のためWHO通知対象外だが、国際貿易への影響と対象国関連性から要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Synthetic shuttlecocks introduced as bird flu impacts feather supply chain
article.articleSummary: Global shortage of duck and goose feathers driven by bird flu outbreaks and shifts in poultry production pushes the Badminton World Federation to approve synthetic shuttlecocks for selected tournaments. The move, reported per BBC report dated April 8, 2026, comes as China, the world's top shuttlecock producer, diversifies production and rising demand for both food and feather materials strain supply chains. BWF will start trials of synthetic shuttlecocks in Grade 3 and junior international events to evaluate performance with input from players, officials, and organizers. Traditional shuttlecocks rely on 16 feathers to ensure flight characteristics, presenting challenges amid supply disruptions. The decision aims to mitigate shortages, maintain competition schedules, and reduce dependence on natural feathers while monitoring acceptability, durability, and cost across affected tournaments.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザが羽毛サプライチェーンに影響を与える中、合成シャトルコック（バドミントン用羽根）が導入される
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザによる羽毛供給への経済的影響が報告されているが、ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の直接的な危機性が記事に明示されていない。スクリーニング基準1項目該当（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）だが、情報不足のため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザ発生による経済的影響（羽毛供給チェーンへの影響）を扱っており、ヒト感染事例の報告がない。『Human Infection with Avian Influenza』は疾患タグとしてAPI側が付与しているが、記事サマリーではヒト感染には言及されていない。中国でのカモ・ガチョウの羽毛生産への長期的な影響が継続する可能性はあるが、公衆衛生上の急性危機とは判定されない。

article.articleHeadline: Kabupaten Tasikmalaya Masuk Status KLB Campak, Dinkes Gelar Imunisasi Sasar 129.000 Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tasikmalaya Regency Enters Measles Outbreak Status, Health Department Holds Immunization Drive Targeting 129,000 Children.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 April 2026, Tasikmalaya Regency, West Java, declares a measles outbreak (KLB) after 122 suspected cases since January 2026, with 14 laboratory-confirmed infections by Labkesda Provinsi Jawa Barat; no deaths reported. Most cases are concentrated in Leuwisari (Sukaratu) and Padakembang (Mekarjaya, Linggawangi). Patients are being treated in hospital isolation rooms. The Dinas Kesehatan will conduct Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) from 13–17 April 2026, targeting 129,000 children across the regency, to curb transmission. Lab samples have been sent to Labkesda Provinsi Jawa Barat; results are pending. The surge is attributed to significant under-vaccination among toddlers, with health authorities coordinating with Puskesmas and Posyandu for vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: タシクマラヤ県麻疹アウトブレイク認定、保健局が129,000人の子どもを対象に予防接種キャンペーン実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの西ジャワ州タシクマラヤで麻疹のアウトブレイク（KLB）が宣言され、2026年1月以降122件の疑い例と14件の確認例が報告されている。麻疹はIHR通知対象疾患であり、ワクチン予防可能感染症にもかかわらず集団発生が生じている点で異常性があり、公衆衛生的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 麻疹はWHO優先疾患であり、IHR附属書2の通知基準該当。西ジャワ州での公式アウトブレイク宣言、病院での隔離治療、大規模予防接種対応（ORI）の実施が報告されている。ワクチン接種率低下が根本原因として言及されており、地域レベルでの対応能力確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lấp khoảng trống giám sát sau vụ 300 tấn thịt lợn bệnh tuồn vào trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Closing surveillance gaps after the incident of 300 tons of diseased pork being smuggled into a school.
article.articleSummary: An African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak involving 3,600 pigs, equating to roughly 300 tons of pork, was uncovered in Hanoi, Vietnam. The investigation identifies Cuong Phat Food Co., Ltd as the hub of slaughter, processing, and distribution, supplying ASF-positive pork to 26 elementary schools and numerous private kindergartens in Hanoi and neighboring provinces. Described as an organized crime network, the scheme allegedly involved veterinary staff who aided illegal sale of diseased animals. Under Vietnamese law, ASF-infected pigs must be destroyed and not sold; those who sell such animals face criminal charges for food-safety violations and related offenses, while officials implicated in issuing fake documents face corruption and forgery charges. The case remains under multi-count prosecution with ongoing inquiries into other actors. It highlights the need to tighten school-meal oversight, rigorous supplier vetting, routine auditing, and prompt action to suspend contracts when safety concerns arise.

triage.headline_ja: 300トンの病気の豚肉が学校に流入した事件後、監視体制の隙間を埋める
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラの大規模違法流通事件であり、人間への食品汚染リスク（26校の学校への供給）、異常性、国内管理体制の脆弱性が明らかとなり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、管理可能性）で複数該当。公衆衛生インシデントとしてフルRRAの対象。
triage.notes: AFはしばしば豚に限定されるが、本件は26の小学校・幼稚園への汚染豚肉供給という食品汚染インシデントであり、人間への曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）が存在。組織的犯罪ネットワークと公式の関与（腐敗）が示唆され、管理可能性の懸念が高い。ベトナムの食品安全・学校給食監視体制の脆弱性が露呈した重要インシデント。
