article.articleHeadline: HHS Funds Gain-of-Function Influenza-COVID 'Frankenvirus' Combining Influenza Entry Machinery With SARS-CoV-2 Human Cell-Binding Domain
article.articleSummary: HHS-backed researchers engineered influenza-based chimeras by fusing influenza hemagglutinin (HA) with the SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain (RBD), creating a higher-affinity human ACE2-binding interface within an influenza backbone. In these constructs, the native HA gene is replaced by the SARS-CoV-2 RBD while virions remain HA-coated, yielding viruses that combine influenza entry machinery with the SARS-CoV-2 binding interface. Described as introducing a stronger human cell-binding mechanism into an influenza system, the work aligns with gain-of-function definitions involving altered receptor usage and host range. A December 2025 bioRxiv preprint confirms the results, funded in part by the NIH under grant P01-AI165075. Authors include Jonathan Munro, Diana Melnyk, Madeeha Afzal, Lisa Schimanski, Alexander A. Cohen, Jennifer R. Keeffe, Pamela J. Bjorkman, William S. James, Alain R. Townsend, and Tiong Kit Tan, with affiliations to University of Oxford (Weatherall Institute of Molecular Medicine; Sir William Dunn School of Pathology), the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences-Oxford Institute, and the California Institute of Technology.

triage.headline_ja: HHS資金提供による鳥インフルエンザ-COVID『フランケンウイルス』研究：インフルエンザ侵入機構とSARS-CoV-2ヒト細胞結合ドメインの組み合わせ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。機能獲得型のキメラウイルス研究は重大なバイオセキュリティ懸念であり、公開される学術論文として国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 本件は実際の流行事象ではなく、学術研究（機能獲得型研究）の報道である。記事サマリーに基づき、実験機関はオックスフォード大学（英国）、カリフォルニア工科大学（米国）、および中国医学科学院-オックスフォード研究所が関与しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはChina（1814991）のみ。バイオセキュリティと公開情報に関する国際的懸念が高く、フルRRA検討の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Com avanço da chikungunya em MS, entenda os perigos da doença para gestantes e bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As chikungunya advances in Mato Grosso do Sul, understand the dangers of the disease for pregnant women and babies.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreaks persist in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 1,764 confirmed cases across 16 municipalities as of the SES report on April 1. Among patients, 37 are pregnant. Infected pregnant women face substantial risks including preterm birth, abortion, and potential neonatal complications such as low birth weight or neonatal death. Vertical transmission to the newborn can occur in up to ~50% of intrapartum infections, with neonates presenting high fever, neurological issues, seizures, cerebral palsy, encephalitis, meningitis, hemorrhagic symptoms, or later-onset signs around days 3–7. Fever during pregnancy is a key warning sign. Prevention emphasizes eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding and using effective repellents: 20–25% icari­dine (icaridine) providing 10–12 hours of protection; DEET is safe for pregnant women but shorter-acting. A chikungunya vaccine trial plans to deliver over 46,000 doses to Mato Grosso do Sul; pregnant women are not in the target group. SUS provides diagnostics and symptomatic treatment with hydration and rest.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でのジカウイルス感染症の拡大に伴い、妊婦と乳幼児に対する疾病の危険性を理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州で1,764例の確認感染者を伴うチクングニア熱の継続的な集団発生があり、特に妊婦37名を含む。垂直感染リスク（周産期感染で最大50%）、新生児の重篤な神経学的合併症（脳炎、髄膜炎、脳性麻痺など）が報告されており、重症度基準およびWHO国際的関心基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア熱とUnknown Encephalitisの両方を疾患名に含むが、サマリーはチクングニア熱の垂直感染と新生児脳炎に焦点を当てている。妊婦および新生児への高リスク群存在、ベクター（Aedes aegypti）による継続的な曝露、ワクチン試行中（46,000用量予定）という管理可能性の文脈から、WPRO基準で4項目該当。ただしIHR基準は1項目のみ該当のため、シグナル認定はスクリーニング基準の複数該当と社会政治的関心に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: Walikale : recrudescence inquiétante de cas de diarrhée dans le groupement Waloa Uroba, les structures sanitaires débordées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Walikale: Alarming resurgence of diarrhea cases in the Waloa Uroba groupement, health facilities overwhelmed.
article.articleSummary: Diarrheal outbreak in Walikale, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the Waloa Uroba groupement hardest hit; Mpenekalenge and Tanganika report the most alarming surge over the past two weeks. Health facilities are overwhelmed by an increasing number of patients and face a critical shortage of medicines, hindering proper care. The Kibua health zone plans an on-site supervisory mission to quantify cases and mount a response. The situation is set against a fragile humanitarian context, with hundreds of displaced people from Masisi fleeing violence between FARDC with wazalendo and AFC/M23. Authorities urge rapid humanitarian and institutional support to prevent a potential major public health catastrophe; no pathogen or confirmed case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: Walikale：Waloa Uroba地区での下痢症例の懸念される再発生、保健施設が過負荷状態
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国の北キブ州で下痢の集団発生が報告され、保健施設が過負荷状態にあり医薬品不足が深刻。脆弱な人道危機環境下での公衆衛生への重大な影響と、国際的支援の必要性が示唆されており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 病原体が特定されていないため詳細なリスク評価に情報が不足している。ただし、脆弱な人道危機環境（Masisiからの避難民）、保健施設の過負荷状態、医薬品不足など、管理可能性に関する懸念が高い。フルRRAで病原体特定と症例数の確認が優先される。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh Measles Crisis Is a Warning India Cannot Ignore
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh reports more than 100 measles deaths in one of the region’s worst outbreaks, triggering an emergency vaccination campaign to protect over 1.2 million children. The episode highlights how small immunisation gaps can spark crises. Measles, highly contagious, requires about 95% two-dose coverage for herd immunity; regional WHO updates (2025) estimate first-dose at 93% and second-dose at 88%. In India, vaccination has expanded: Mission Indradhanush reached 5.46 crore children and 1.32 crore pregnant women; measles vaccination rose from 83% in 2013 to 93% in 2023. WHO/UNICEF 2024 notes zero-dose reductions from 1.6 million (2023) to 0.9 million (2024). High-risk pockets remain in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Assam, plus migrant urban clusters in Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat. The gap lies in delivery and surveillance, not supply; bolstering early detection, trust, and targeted campaigns is essential.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュはしかの危機はインドが無視できない警告
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで100人以上の麻疹死亡者を伴う地域最悪の集団発生が報告され、インドにおける予防接種カバレッジのギャップと高リスク地域が明確に特定されている。国際的な懸念と広域的な予防接種キャンペーンの必要性が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドの麻疹リスク状況とバングラデシュでの集団発生からの教訓である。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。インド国内の複数州（ビハール州、ウッタルプラデシュ州、マディヤプラデシュ州、ラージャスターン州、アッサム州、マハーラーシュトラ州、カルナータカ州、グジャラート州）で予防接種カバレッジのギャップと高リスク集団が特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhoea Outbreak Hits Mayurbhanj Ashram School, Dozens Fall Ill | Odisha
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoeal outbreak at Kakbandh Ashram School in Rasgovindpur block, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha, sickening around 60 students according to families, while school authorities report 15 ill. Affected pupils were admitted to Rasgovindpur Community Health Centre. Family accounts point to contaminated meals—pakhala (fermented rice), mashed potatoes, and mango chutney—with alleged stale food served. Symptoms described include diarrhoea and vomiting; onset reportedly began around 8:00 a.m., but transport to care was delayed until about 3:30 p.m. Parents accuse school officials of negligence and are demanding a thorough investigation and accountability. Local residents are calling for clarity on the outbreak’s source and handling. The report provides no lab-confirmed results or final casualty counts.

triage.headline_ja: 下痢の集団発生がマユールバンジ・アシュラム学校を襲う、数十人が発症 | オディシャ州
triage.triage_reason: 未知の病因による下痢の集団発症イベントであり異常性は高いが、学校内の限定的な集団発生と見られ、国際的拡大リスクや重症度の情報が不足している。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 病因が未確定（Unknown Illnessと分類）であり、検査結果・最終患者数が報告されていない。感染源は食事の汚染が疑われているが確定していない。学校内の限定的な集団発生と現在判断される。死亡者や重症者の報告もなし。続報で病因特定と感染範囲の拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DNCC targets 500,000 children in emergency measles drive
article.articleSummary: Measles and rubella vaccination drive launched by Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) targets about 500,000 children aged six months to five years across 599 vaccination centres in 10 Dhaka zones. State Minister for Health and Family Welfare MA Muhit inaugurated the campaign in Korail; it runs through May 11. DNCC has set up 54 permanent and 502 temporary centres, plus 35 evening centres and eight Friday centres to maximise coverage. Deployment includes 594 health workers, 650 volunteers, and 203 supervisors. The campaign began in 17 Upazilas and four city corporations and will expand nationwide starting April 20. DNCC Administrator Shafiqul Islam Khan announced plans to convert the Mohakhali DNCC COVID Hospital into a general hospital to broaden broader public healthcare capacity.

triage.headline_ja: DNCC、緊急麻疹キャンペーンで50万人の子どもを対象
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の予防接種キャンペーンは感染症対策として重要だが、これは新規の疾患アウトブレイクではなく計画された公衆衛生介入である。異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はバングラデシュ（対象国リストに未含）での予防接種キャンペーンだが、Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUttar Pradesh（インド）が含まれている。記事サマリーではインドでの疾患発生は明記されておらず、言及されているのはバングラデシュのダッカと周辺地域のみ。COVID-19の言及もキャンペーン背景としての参考（COVID病院の用途変更）に過ぎない。verified_locationsにはインドを含めたが、実際の疾患イベントはバングラデシュに限定されている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Instituto Biota emite alerta sobre riscos de gripe aviária no litoral de Alagoas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Biota Institute issues alert about avian influenza risks on the Alagoas coast.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza alert issued by Biota Institute of Conservation warns that migrating birds along the Alagoas coast may be infected, posing a real risk to human health due to the virus’s high transmissibility. The warning notes that seasonal bird movements increase the presence of debilitated or dead birds on beaches, but everyone should avoid any contact with living or dead birds. The specialist stresses that attempting to help an animal can expose people to the virus. If a bird is seen in a suspicious condition, do not handle it or bring it home; instead, isolate the area and promptly contact the appropriate authorities for safe removal and implementation of sanitary measures. Reporting can be made to the Biota Institute by telephone.

triage.headline_ja: Biota研究所がアラゴアス州沿岸の鳥インフルエンザリスクについて警告を発行
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの鳥インフルエンザ警告だが、現在のところ人間への感染症例の報告はなく、リスク警告段階。スクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザの潜在的リスク警告であり、確認された人間感染症例ではない。季節的な渡り鳥の移動に関連した鳥への曝露リスクが主題。Biota研究所による公開警告であり社会的関心あり。情報不足であるため、続報を注視する段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: ییلو فیور کے خلاف جنگ میں بڑی کامیابی نئی ویکسین بھی مؤثر ثابت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Major breakthrough in the fight against Yellow Fever; the new vaccine has also proven effective.
article.articleSummary: Yellow Fever vaccine breakthrough: Sanofi's new vYF vaccine matches the existing YF-VAX in efficacy and safety. In a phase 3 trial involving 485 healthy adults aged 18–60, 99.7% of those receiving vYF developed protective antibodies within 28 days, versus 99.4% for YF-VAX; antibody levels remained comparable for one year. No major adverse events were reported. The vaccine is produced in Vero cells, enabling large-scale, rapid manufacture. Global Yellow Fever deaths are estimated at 29,000–60,000 annually; past outbreaks in Central Africa and Brazil led to vaccine shortages. If approved, vYF could alleviate shortages, reduce costs, and improve access in remote areas, strengthening outbreak control and vaccination coverage.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病との闘いにおける大きな成功：新しいワクチンも有効であることが証明された
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはワクチン開発の成功に関するニュースであり、新たな感染症の発生やアウトブレイクではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれにも該当せず、感染症危機管理対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は黄熱病の新規ワクチン（vYF）の臨床試験成功に関するニュースである。過去のアウトブレイク（Central AfricaおよびBrazil）に言及されているが、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントの報告ではなく、ワクチン開発進捗の報道であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: SES-MS confirma mais 2 mortes por chikungunya e total chega a 10 em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SES-MS confirms two more deaths due to chikungunya, and the total reaches 10 in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Two additional chikungunya deaths confirmed in Mato Grosso do Sul on Apr 10, raising 2026 fatalities to 10. Jardim (94-year-old man with hypertension and diabetes) and Fátima do Sul (82-year-old man with diabetes and hypertension) are the latest. MS reports 4,281 probable cases, with 2,102 confirmed and 2,179 suspected awaiting Lacen results (about 50.9% pending). Seventeen municipalities have epidemic-level incidence (>300/100k); state rate is 155.3/100k. Jardim incidence is 1,338.6/100k (44 new probable in 7 days); Fátima do Sul 2,518.3/100k. Earlier in 2026, Jardim recorded an 82-year-old woman death (Mar 23) and Bonito a 72-year-old man (Mar 19). Dourados reports six indigenous deaths; four more under investigation, including a 12-year-old boy and a 10-year-old girl. A field hospital is set up in a school gym; fever, severe joint/muscle pain, headaches, red spots are common symptoms, with neuroinvasive risk in some cases.

triage.headline_ja: SES-MS confirms two more deaths due to chikungunya, and the total reaches 10 in 2026
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニア熱の死亡事例の急速な増加（2026年で10例）と複数市での流行レベルの感染率が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当。複数自治体での高い疾病発生率と死亡例により公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジル（Mato Grosso do Sul州）でのチクングニア熱の死亡例増加および流行報告。17自治体で流行レベルの感染率（>300/100k）が確認されており、疾病管理能力の問題が示唆される。先住民コミュニティでも複数の死亡例報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Übertragung von Erregern: Handel mit Wildtieren erhöht Risiko für Epidemien
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transmission of Pathogens: Trade in Wild Animals Increases the Risk of Epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Wildlife trade involves about a quarter of mammal species and heightens human exposure to pathogens. A Science study analyzing four decades of data (1980–2019) and CITES trade records of 2,079 mammal species found that 41% of traded species shared at least one pathogen with humans, versus 6.4% of non-traded wild species. The authors report that traded wild mammals are about 1.5 times more likely to share viruses, bacteria, fungi, or parasites with people. On average, a species adds one more human pathogen for every ten years it remains on the market. Species cited include pangolins, elephants, bears, and hedgehogs; the study excludes domesticated animals. The researchers call for intensified surveillance of wildlife trade and products and for consumer responsibility, noting how past spillovers—Ebola, HIV, Mpox, and likely Covid-19 originating from wildlife trade in China—underline the risk, though definitive transmission chains are still debated due to limited access to data.

triage.headline_ja: 病原体の伝播：野生動物の取引は感染症の流行リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は野生動物取引と人獣共通感染症リスクの関連性に関する科学研究の報告であり、特定の現行イベント（アウトブレイク）を描写していない。過去の事例（エボラ、HIV、Mpox、COVID-19）を引用していますが、現在進行形の感染症危機の兆候ではなく、政策レベルの構造的リスク警告と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は科学的な流行病学研究論文の報道であり、現在のアウトブレイクを報告しているものではない。記事サマリーでは過去のCOVID-19原点にChinaが言及されているが、現在のイベント発生ではなく、歴史的リスク要因の分析である。野生動物取引という構造的リスク因子は国際的に関連するが、具体的な地域限定のクライシスではないため、スクリーニング基準の該当は「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に基づいている。

article.articleHeadline: Új vírus pusztít Európában! Megbénítja az ízületeket, nagyon súlyos lehet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New virus devastates Europe! It paralyzes the joints and could be very serious.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-12, chikungunya virus poses rising European risk as the Aedes albopictus vector expands across the continent. In the United Kingdom, chikungunya cases rose about 43%, with concerns over sustained local transmission beyond travelers returning from India, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh. The tropical disease causes high fever, severe joint and muscle pain, headache, rash, and photophobia; in some patients pain persists for months or years. European outbreaks are increasingly linked to the Asian tiger mosquito, now found in France and Italy, signaling broader establishment. Studies show the virus can survive and spread at temperatures as low as 2.5°C, extending potential seasonal and geographic windows. While vaccines exist, they are expensive and limited; therefore mosquito-bite prevention remains essential: repellents, long clothing, nets, and removing standing water. First identified in Tanzania in 1952, Europe has seen sporadic cases in recent years, with France and Italy reporting hundreds in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいウイルスがヨーロッパで猛威を振るっている！関節を麻痺させ、非常に深刻になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）該当。チクングニア熱がヨーロッパで既に確立・拡大し、蚊のベクター確立により持続的な伝播リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリア、フランス、英国でのチクングニア熱確認を述べているが、これらはスクリーニング対象国ではない。対象国としてはインドが唯一該当（英国から返国者がインドから帰国したことに関連）。ただし本イベントはWPRO地域外（ヨーロッパ中心）のため、WPRO域内への波及監視が重要。蚊ベクターの確立と温度適応による拡大リスクが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Menino de 8 anos morre com suspeita de meningite no Recife: Família aponta negligência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8-year-old boy dies with suspected meningitis in Recife: Family alleges negligence.
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old Benjamin Leite Costa died in Recife with suspected meningitis after rapid deterioration during Holy Week travel from Gravatá (Pernambuco) to Recife, with intermediate visits to UPAs in Gravatá, Pau Amarelo, and Jardim Paulista. At Hospital Geral de Areias, dengue was ruled out but the bacterial cause remained inconclusive; antibiotics triggered a skin reaction, prompting an improvised ICU in the ward and a transfer attempt to Oswaldo Cruz that arrived late. He died before transfer. The case is under investigation by the State Health Secretariat; prophylaxis for close contacts is advised and no mass school closures are recommended, though Benjamin’s school suspended activities for cleaning. The event highlights delays in emergency transfers and hospital flow during holidays in Pernambuco.

triage.headline_ja: レシフェで髄膜炎の疑いで死亡した8歳の少年：家族が医療上の過失を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡事例（髄膜炎疑い、細菌性は未確定）であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当は不明。ただし重症度（死亡）と社会的関心（医療過失への言及）が認められるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事見出しは『デング熱』と分類されているが、サマリーの内容は髄膜炎（細菌性の疑い）の単一死亡事例である。デング除外との記述があるため分類タグと実際のイベント内容に矛盾がある。緊急転送の遅延と病院機能の問題が強調されているが、伝播の可能性や流行性については情報不足。州保健事務局による調査が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Govt takes swift steps to control measles: Dr Rafiqul | Others
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts rapid vaccination drive in Bangladesh. The government launched a nationwide measles-rubella immunization campaign under the Rural Society Development Programme, inaugurated in Ward No. 13 of Shantinagar, Dhaka. The campaign began April 5 in high-risk districts and runs in phases through May 11, with about 450,000 children to be vaccinated in Dhaka South City Corporation at around 450 permanent and temporary centers. The effort covers four city corporations including Dhaka; aims to curb measles and rubella. Authorities attribute rising cases to previous disruptions in vaccination programs and emphasize mass immunization, supported by expert consultations and ongoing nationwide activities. No case counts or fatalities are provided in this report.

triage.headline_ja: 政府が麻疹制御に向けた迅速な対策を実施：ラフィクル博士
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで麻疹・風疹の集団発生が報告され、政府による大規模予防接種キャンペーンが展開されている。異常事象および重症度の懸念、流行リスク、長期曝露の可能性が認識される。
triage.notes: バングラデシュで麻疹・風疹の発生が確認されており、政府による全国的な予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。インドもBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではインドに関する言及がないため、verified_locationsにはバングラデシュのみを列挙した。死亡者数や確定症例数が記事に明記されていないため、重症度は「不明」と評価。IHR基準2つ以上該当およびWPRO基準複数該当、政府・社会的関心の高さから、フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の対象とすべきシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak confirmed in Kottayam district
article.articleSummary: As of 12 April 2026, H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza is confirmed in Ward 16 of Udayanapuram grama panchayat, Vaikom taluk, Kottayam district, prompting intensified preventive measures. District Collector Chetan Kumar Meena chaired a District Disaster Management Authority meeting, which ordered the culling of poultry stock and other domestic birds within a 1-km infected zone and established a 10-km surveillance zone. The sale, transport, and use of eggs, meat, manure, and other poultry products from ducks, chickens, quails, and other domesticated birds are banned for three days within the 10-km radius. Affected local bodies include Vaikom municipality and the panchayats Chempu, Maravanthuruthu, TV Puram, Thalayazham, Kallara, Thalayolaparambu, Kaduthuruthy. Containment emphasizes biosecurity and monitoring to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケラナ州コッタヤム地区で鳥インフルエンザの感染が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数該当。H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザはシグナルピックアップの基準を満たす。
triage.notes: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの確認は重大シグナル。コッタヤム地区での爆発的拡大リスク、ケララ州の農業・公衆衛生への深刻な影響、および周辺国（特にバングラデシュ、ミャンマー、タイ）への国際的な拡大リスクが懸念される。District Disaster Management Authorityによる迅速な対応（家禽の大量殺処分、3日間の移動・販売禁止）が実施されている。フルRRAに進んで詳細なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Investigan a científica por presunto robo de virus altamente contagiosos en laboratorio de Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A scientist is being investigated for alleged theft of highly contagious viruses at a laboratory in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Argentine scientist Soledad Palameta Miller, 35, is under investigation for alleged theft of highly contagious virus samples from a NB-3 biosafety level lab at the University of Campinas (Unicamp) in Campinas, Brazil. On February 13, missing boxes containing samples from the animal virology unit of the Institute of Biology were reported, including dengue, Zika, chikungunya, Epstein-Barr virus, herpesviruses, coronavirus, and influenza A (H1N1) and A (H3N2). Federal Police and ANVISA conducted raids, recovering material in freezers at the university’s Faculty of Economics and Administration. Palameta Miller was detained but granted provisional freedom as the probe into illegal transport and related irregularities continues. She has a background in virus work and collaborated on projects with Clarice Arns on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), avian metapneumovirus, and infectious bronchitis virus; her husband Michael Edward Miller is also under scrutiny for possible involvement.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの研究所で高感染性ウイルスの盗難の疑いで科学者が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: 高度なバイオセーフティレベル(BSL-3)施設からの複数の高感染性ウイルス試料盗難の疑いであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の重大事象、国際的拡大リスク、国家間の対応必要性を満たすIHR基準に該当。バイオセキュリティ上の重大な懸念事項。
triage.notes: BSL-3施設からのデング、ジカ、チクングニア、コロナウイルス、インフルエンザA(H1N1、H3N2)、RSVなど複数の高感染性病原体試料の盗難疑いは、生物兵器化や不正な国際移動のリスクを含むバイオセキュリティ上の重大事象。アルゼンチン国籍の科学者が容疑者で、国境を超えた関与の可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Idoso é encontrado com larvas no corpo e em situação grave em MS | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly man found with larvae in his body and in serious condition in Mato Grosso do Sul | G1
article.articleSummary: On 12 April 2026, an 83-year-old man was found in extreme neglect at a home in Selvíria, Mato Grosso do Sul, with larvae on his body (myiasis), dehydration, malnutrition, and multiple injuries. A report to CREAS prompted police-assisted investigators to the residence, where he was found lying on a bed, unclothed and crying out in pain, amid feces from humans and animals. He was transported by ambulance to a local hospital, then transferred to Hospital Auxiliadora in Três Lagoas due to the severity of his condition. The case is being investigated as elder abuse; his daughter, 60, who said she was the caregiver, could face charges if neglect is confirmed. The investigation is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢男性が体にウジが湧いた状態で発見され、重篤な状況にあるとして調査される（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）

article.articleHeadline: Exame de sangue com IA facilita diagnóstico precoce da hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AI-powered blood test facilitates early diagnosis of leprosy.
article.articleSummary: Blood-based testing combined with a clinical questionnaire and artificial intelligence enables earlier detection of leprosy in Brazil. Researchers from USP Ribeirão Preto, with FAPESP support, used blood samples from a COVID-19 serosurvey in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, to test a new diagnostic approach for Mycobacterium leprae exposure. The strategy combines a clinical suspicion questionnaire (QSH) enhanced by AI (MaLeSQs) and a blood assay detecting anti-Mce1A antibodies (IgA, IgM, IgG) in contrast to the traditional anti-PGL-I test. The assay differentiates exposure, active infection, and prior contact. In 195 analyzed samples from about 700 invited participants, 12 new cases were diagnosed after clinical evaluation. IgM against Mce1A provided the best performance, identifying two thirds of new cases; when combined with AI, sensitivity reached 100%. Georeferenced mapping showed a diffuse exposure pattern across the study area.

triage.headline_ja: AI搭載血液検査によりブラジルでハンセン病の早期診断が容易に
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の新しい診断方法開発に関する科学的進展記事であり、公衆衛生への顕著な負の影響や異常な疾病発生を示す証拠に乏しい。12新規症例の診断は検査感度向上の結果であり、流行状況の悪化を示すものではない。続報にてハンセン病の疫学的動向確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はハンセン病診断技術の開発と検証であり、疾病制御状況の報告ではない。ブラジルではハンセン病が風土病として存在するため、prolonged_exposureをYesと評価。しかし診断方法改善のニュースであり、公衆衛生危機の兆候は見当たらない。continued monitoring推奨。

article.articleHeadline: لدغات البعوض تنقله: لقاح حديث لحمى الصفراء - الإمارات نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito bites transmit it: A new vaccine for yellow fever - Emirates News
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever, transmitted by mosquitoes, vaccine vYF, a live attenuated vaccine, shows non-inferiority to the licensed YF-VAX in Phase 2 trials. Conducted in adults 18-60: 485 participants; 329 received vYF, 156 received YF-VAX. By day 28, 99.7% of vYF recipients developed protective antibodies, vs 99.4% for YF-VAX by day 30. Antibody levels peaked on day 29 and then declined over the following year to levels similar to licensed vaccines. Safety: no serious adverse events; common mild side effects such as headaches and injection-site pain; no withdrawals. Vaccine produced in cell lines derived from African green monkey kidney, enabling higher yields and more efficient production. Rationale: global yellow fever vaccine shortages amid outbreaks in Central Africa and Brazil; vYF aims to improve manufacturing capacity and supply. If regulatory steps proceed, this could bolster global preparedness to respond to yellow fever outbreaks and ease stock pressures.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊刺しで感染：黄熱病の新しいワクチン - エミラーツニュース
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病ワクチン開発の臨床試験結果の報道であり、直接的な患者数増加や新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし、中央アフリカ、ブラジルでの既存の黄熱病発生状況への対応という文脈があり、ワクチン供給不足への言及があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は黄熱病ワクチン（vYF）の臨床試験結果についての医学・科学的報道である。新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既存の中央アフリカ・ブラジルでのアウトブレイク対応文脈での報告。サマリーに「中央アフリカと北米のアウトブレイク」と記載されているがサマリー本体では具体的な患者数やイベント詳細は記載されず、文脈のみの言及である。フルRRA不要だが、黄熱病の国際動向監視という観点から注視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: تنقله لدغات البعوض.. التوصل للقاح جديد لعدوى الحمى الصفراء - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transmitted by mosquito bites... A new vaccine for yellow fever infection - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccine vYF, a live-attenuated vaccine produced by a global pharmaceutical company, matches the licensed YF-VAX in a Phase II trial among healthy adults aged 18–60. In the study, 329 received vYF and 156 received YF-VAX; seroconversion by day 28–29 was 99.7% vs 99.4%, with antibody levels peaking on day 29 and then gradually declining to similar levels over the following year. No serious adverse events or withdrawals occurred and side effects were generally mild (headache, injection-site pain). Yellow fever is a mosquito-borne viral disease causing fever, liver failure, bleeding, and jaundice, with an estimated 29,000–60,000 deaths annually; WHO urges vaccination for high-risk regions and travelers. Past outbreaks in Africa (Angola, DRC) and Brazil strained global vaccine stocks in 2015–2016. The vaccine uses Vero cells from African green monkey kidney to boost yield. If approved, vYF could strengthen outbreak response and supply.

article.articleHeadline: Wildlife Trade: Increasing the Risk of Zoonotic Disease Spillover - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: April 2026 study links wildlife trade to increased zoonotic spillover risk, with 60% of human pathogens tied to spillovers from wild or domestic animals. Exotics trade for food, traditional medicine, or pets creates pathways for pathogens to jump to humans. Notable examples: 2003 mpox outbreak in the United States triggered by shipment of exotic African rodents to Illinois pet store; prairie dogs infected nearly 100 people. Ebola outbreaks linked to bat contact. COVID-19 is suggested to have originated at the Huanan Seafood Wholesale Market in Wuhan, where live wild animals such as Himalayan marmots, civets, and raccoon dogs were kept in cramped quarters, enabling transmission. The trade involves pangolins, giant rats, and other exotic species. A single encounter can potentially cause thousands or millions of deaths. Legal and illegal trades hinder surveillance and prevention.

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ dịch sốt xuất huyết bùng phát kỷ lục trong năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Risk of a record-breaking dengue fever outbreak in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Global dengue fever risk rises in 2026 as climate change and El Niño elevate outbreaks. The AMRO/WHO director says dengue is a public health indicator, driven by Aedes transmission. Cases rose from ~500,000 in 2000 to over 14 million in 2024, with ~10,000 deaths. El Niño links to larger waves; 62% probability June–August, up to 80% in autumn; Nature analyses tie waves to 4.1 million and 9.6 million extra cases in 2015–16 and 2023–24. At a Lyon summit, Kenya joined the Dengue Alliance with Thailand, India, Malaysia, and Brazil; EU funding ~€20 million to accelerate research. Vaccines: Brazil’s Butantan licensed 2025 with 80.5% protection against hospitalization; Takeda’s Qdenga approved in Europe, not US or reimbursed. 13 treatments are in development; France’s IRD studies saliva-based transmission blockers. Vector-control using bacteria-infected mosquitoes piloted in Brazil and Peru to protect ~140 million over 10 years. In 2025, dengue cases exceed 181,000; proactive prevention urged.

article.articleHeadline: Ancient Child Remains in Vietnam Show Evidence of Syphilis-Like Disease - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Three cases of congenital treponematosis were documented in Neolithic Vietnam at two sites dating 3,300–4,100 years ago, including a 5-year-old from Man Bac with skeletal lesions in teeth and bones consistent with congenital disease. The research, published March 13, 2026 in the International Journal of Osteoarchaeology, confirms maternal transmission and shows congenital treponemal infection in Stone Age populations. Treponemal diseases arise from Treponema pallidum subspecies and related forms, and these findings challenge the view that syphilis-like infections originated solely in the Americas. Instead, they imply prehistoric Southeast Asian circulation of treponematoses. The skeletal evidence provides a physical record of disease impact, indicating population-level exposure beyond adulthood and contributing to understanding of the evolution and spread of treponemal infections.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの古代人骨から梅毒様疾患の証拠を発見

article.articleHeadline: Prehistoric children's remains show syphilis-like disease spread through ancient Vietnam - study
article.articleSummary: Vietnamese skeletal remains from 16 sites dated 10,000–1,000 years ago include three children (18 months, 5 years, 2.5 years) from Man Bac (northern Vietnam) and An Son (southern Vietnam) with congenital treponematosis dated ~4,100–3,300 years ago. Distinctive dental abnormalities and skeletal lesions indicate infection by treponemal diseases (syphilis, yaws, bejel, pinta). This suggests congenital transmission can occur in non-venereal treponematoses, challenging the view that only syphilis is congenitally transmitted. Across 309 individuals from 16 sites, about 10% bore treponemal signs, mainly in children/adolescents, consistent with non-sexual transmission. The findings invite caution in interpreting skeletal lesions as congenital syphilis and challenge the Columbus-origin theory for syphilis in Europe. Lead author Dr. Melandri Vlok notes broader implications for interpreting ancient infections and disease transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sampang temukan 90 warga diduga menderita campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sampang Health Office finds 90 residents suspected of having measles.
article.articleSummary: Ninety residents in Sampang, East Java, are suspected of measles as of March 31, 2026, per the Sampang Health Office. Of these, 11 samples have been sent for laboratory confirmation to the Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan (BBLK) Surabaya. Cases are spread across nearly all districts, with the highest numbers at Puskesmas Banyuanyar, Tambelangan, and Robatal, where more than 10 patients are under care. Common symptoms include fever up to 40°C, dry cough, runny nose, red or watery eyes, and Koplik spots, followed by a maculopapular red rash that typically appears 3–5 days after onset, beginning behind the ears and face and spreading to the body. Additional signs include reduced appetite, malaise, diarrhea or vomiting. Sampang is among Madura Island districts with high measles burden; in 2025, the district recorded 653 measles cases, mostly children aged 9 months to 7 years, alongside neighboring districts Sumenep, Pamekasan, and Bangkalan.

Despite its small size, the insect causes notable discomfort for people and animals and can drive community disruption. The article flags a possible link to Oropouche fever, a viral disease; specific symptoms are not listed and diagnosis may be confused with dengue and chikungunya. No case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided. The report underscores the need for ongoing environmental control and health surveillance to mitigate transmission risk and protect quality of life amid hot, humid regional conditions.

Across the state, 17 municipalities are experiencing outbreaks; eight other deaths occurred earlier in March (Jardim, Bonito). In Dourados, six indigenous victims (ages 69, 60, 73, 55, and two male infants, 1 month and 3 months) with dates ranging Feb–Mar. The Aedes aegypti vector drives transmission; prevention guidance from the Ministry of Health is provided.

article.articleHeadline: 男子被竹屑刺伤染上破伤风进ICU，哪些伤口更容易得破伤风？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man punctured by bamboo splinters contracts tetanus and is admitted to the ICU; which wounds are more likely to develop tetanus?
article.articleSummary: Meizhou, Guangdong Province, China reports a tetanus case after bamboo splinter puncture of the finger, with debris under the skin, leading to ICU admission. Clostridium tetani, common in soil and excreta, infects wounds that are deep, dirty, or contaminated. Incubation is typically 3–21 days (shortest 1 day; rarely beyond six months). Tetanus neurotoxins cause two phases: trismus with facial grimacing and progressive body rigidity with spasms, plus autonomic dysfunction (sweating, tachycardia, unstable blood pressure). Attacks can be triggered by light, sound, or water and usually last 3–4 weeks; severe cases risk airway compromise and death. Hospitals have admitted about 4–5 severe tetanus cases recently, higher than usual during spring farming. Prevention emphasizes protective gear, prompt wound cleaning and debridement, and timely tetanus vaccination or antitoxin. High-risk wounds include open, deep, contaminated (soil/feces) wounds, rusty wounds, deep puncture wounds, entry-only injuries, and burns with delayed care.

article.articleHeadline: BRIN Ingatkan Risiko Kembalinya Wabah Pes di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN Warns of the Risk of the Plague Returning in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) risk rises in Indonesia, with BRIN warning that Java still harbors enzootic reservoirs for the disease. Although no human plague cases have been reported for more than a decade, scientists warn of a silent period during which the bacteria, vectors (fleas), and reservoir hosts (rats) persist in several Indonesian enzootic areas. Environmental changes—deforestation, land-use shift, and rapid population growth—and climate factors may drive increased flea populations and closer contact with humans, raising transmission risk via flea bites. Focus regions on Java include Pasuruan Regency, Boyolali, Sleman, and Bandung. No laboratory-confirmed human cases are cited. Recommendations call for integrated surveillance across humans, animals, and vectors, improved environmental sanitation, and monitoring of former endemic zones to prevent potential outbreaks. Collaborative research titled Environmental Changes and Risk of Plague Epidemics in Indonesia involves BRIN, Ministry of Health, and partners from China and France.

triage.notes: 記事は現在のペスト流行ではなく、科学的警告と潜在的リスク評価に焦点を当てている。過去10年以上の人間症例がなく、実験室確認症例も報告されていない。ただし、Java地域における風土性保有菌の継続存在と環境変化による感染リスク上昇が指摘されており、今後の症例監視と予防対策の重要性が強調されている。複数国（インドネシア、中国、フランス）による共同研究が進行中。

article.articleSummary: Sampang Regency, East Java, Indonesia reports 90 suspected measles cases as of March 31, 2026, per the Health Office and surveillance/immunization team. Eleven samples have been collected for laboratory testing at Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan (BBLK) Surabaya. Most cases are spread across several health centers, with the highest numbers at Puskesmas Banyuanyar, Tambelangan, and Robatal; patient counts at these clinics are in the dozens. Clinical features include high fever up to 40°C, dry cough, runny nose, red or watery eyes, and Koplik spots inside the mouth, followed by a maculopapular red rash typically appearing 3–5 days after onset, starting behind the ears and face and spreading to the body. Additional symptoms include poor appetite, malaise, diarrhea or vomiting. Sampang is among Madura Island districts with high measles activity; in 2025, 653 measles cases were recorded in the district, mainly in children aged 9 months to 7 years.

Educational messages urged simple daily measures: seal water tanks, dispose of trash properly, and prevent water accumulation in pots and bottles. article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), specifically SAT1, is spreading across Mainland China, reaching at least 12 provinces including Xinjiang and Gansu. article.articleSummary: Measles public health concern in Brazil as of 2026-04-12, with lab-confirmed cases in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. In 2025, Brazil reported 38 infections, all imported. In early 2026, two new cases were identified in major urban centers: a 22-year-old unvaccinated individual in Rio de Janeiro and a baby in São Paulo who had recently returned from La Paz, Bolivia, where an active outbreak is occurring. The current status is not endemic transmission, but authorities have implemented preventive measures, including vaccination in affected areas and strict contact tracing. Brazil aims for 95% vaccination with two doses of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine to maintain herd immunity, a target challenged by lingering gaps post-Covid-19. Measles is highly contagious and airborne, with up to 90% infection risk in non-immune contacts; symptoms include fever, red rash, and itching, potentially leading to severe disease in children and the immunocompromised. The 2019 loss of elimination status remains a historical warning.

Levantamento Rápido de Índices para o Aedes aegypti shows about 80% of breeding sites are indoors, with plant pot trays, buckets, tires, and clogged gutters as key culprits. article.articleHeadline: Exame de sangue associado à IA abre caminho para diagnóstico precoce da hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Blood Test Associated with AI Paves the Way for Early Diagnosis of Hansen's Disease.
article.articleSummary: Blood test paired with AI aids early diagnosis of Hansen's disease (leprosy) in Brazil. Researchers at USP used serum samples from a COVID-19 serosurvey in Ribeirão Preto to screen for exposure to Mycobacterium leprae. Of about 700 invited, 224 completed the clinical-suspicion questionnaire (QSH) and 195 provided blood; 37 attended a clinical evaluation, resulting in 12 diagnosed Hansen's disease cases (≈one third of those evaluated). The assay detects antibodies against Mce1A, a key M. leprae antigen, measuring IgA, IgM, and IgG, unlike conventional anti-PGL-I single-antibody tests; IgM against Mce1A had the best performance, identifying two-thirds of new cases. When combined with the AI-based MaLeSQs questionnaire, the approach reached 100% sensitivity in flagging suspected cases for specialist assessment. The study, published in BMC Infectious Diseases, used georeferenced mapping indicating a diffuse exposure pattern and suggests the method could strengthen screening in Brazil's public health system; costs are similar to existing tests.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de síndromes gripais voltam a crescer e colocam AC em alto risco, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of influenza-like illnesses are rising again and putting Acre at high risk, Fiocruz says.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin, released Apr 9, 2026, reports Acre with rising SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) cases. Data from epidemiological Week 13 (Mar 29–Apr 4, 2026) show Acre and 12 other states at alert/risk with growth in SRAG, notably in Acre, Pará and Tocantins. Over the last four weeks, positives are more common in high‑risk groups (children, elderly, people with comorbidities) and health workers. Detected viruses: Influenza A 30.7%, Influenza B 2.0%, RSV 19.9%, Rhinovirus 40.8%, SARS‑CoV‑2 6.2%. Since year start, 31,768 SRAG cases have been notified; 13,205 lab‑positive, 12,678 negative, about 3,527 pending. In Acre, RSV and Rhinovirus drive pediatric SRAG; mortality higher in the elderly, led by Influenza A and COVID‑19. Vaccination against influenza is the main protection; isolation and mask use advised if symptomatic. Sesacre records 4,173 influenza‑like consultations Jan 4–Mar 21, with 17 deaths. Preventive measures include influenza and pneumococcal vaccination for children from 6 months, hygiene, avoiding sick contacts, and regular pediatric care.

triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのアクレ州を中心とした呼吸器症候群の増加を報告。複数の病原体検出（インフルエンザA 30.7%、RSV 19.9%、ライノウイルス40.8%）があり、小児と高齢者で重症化のリスクあり。4か月間で31,768例のSRAG報告、13,205例が実験室確定。国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断されるが、複数病原体の共流行状況と地域的な増加傾向から経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese Researcher Sentenced for Smuggling E. Coli From China to US
article.articleSummary: Xiang Youhuang, 32, a former Chinese biology researcher at Indiana University Bloomington, was sentenced for smuggling DNA samples of Escherichia coli from China into the United States. While on a J-1 visa, he exploited access to Indiana University laboratory facilities to move E. coli DNA samples abroad. Indicted in December 2025 and pled guilty to one count of smuggling, he received a sentence on April 7, 2026: time served (more than four months), a $500 fine, and one year of supervised release, with removal to China ordered. The case, pursued by the U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Indiana, underscores biosecurity concerns surrounding cross-border transfer of bacterial genetic material and the enforcement of export controls tied to laboratory access at major U.S. research institutions.

article.articleHeadline: DRC Cholera Outbreak: Over 4,600 Cases in South Kivu (Q1 2026) - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with South Kivu reporting >4,600 cases in Q1 2026; the broader outbreak began in 2025 with 29,392 suspected cases and 620 deaths (Jan 1–Jun 8, 2025; CFR ~2%). Early 2026 CFR in South Kivu reaches up to 23.4% in some areas, driven by displacement. Heavily affected provinces include Kinshasa, Tanganyika, Haut-Katanga, Haut-Lomami, North Kivu, and Lualaba. Flooding contaminates water sources; high mobility along the Congo River and concurrent outbreaks of measles and mpox strain health capacity. Lomera, South Kivu, grew from 1,500 to >12,000 residents after a December 2024 gold rush, with sanitation gaps. Government, with WHO and partners, activated the Incident Management System to interrupt transmission and reduce deaths. WHO deployed rapid response teams for lab diagnosis, case investigation, and WASH; emergency kits to treat >10,000, plus eight cholera kits for 800 in North Kivu. MSF treated >600 and vaccinated >8,000 in Lomera.

article.articleHeadline: Kongo central : la jeunesse sensibilisée à la vaccination contre la rougeole et la rubéole - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo Central: Youth educated on measles and rubella vaccination - ACP
article.articleSummary: Matadi, in Kongo Central, Democratic Republic of Congo, on 12 April 2026, ACP reports sensitization on measles, rubella and poliomyelitis vaccination ahead of a 15–19 April 2026 campaign in Matadi and the province. The U-Report community organized the briefing to equip youths to relay messages and mobilize communities. The campaign targets children 6 months to 14 years for measles and rubella vaccination, and 0–59 months for polio, aiming to curb transmission of these preventable diseases. A vice-coordinator emphasized youths as community liaisons to encourage parents to vaccinate and to counter rumors. Vaccination is highlighted as one of the most effective means to reduce child mortality, protect against severe diseases, strengthen herd immunity, and prevent outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Chinese Researcher Sentenced for Smuggling E. Coli From China to US
article.articleSummary: Xiang, a former Chinese biology researcher at Indiana University Bloomington, was sentenced for smuggling DNA samples of Escherichia coli from China to the United States. He exploited access to a flagship IU lab and his J-1 visa to import dangerous biological material, hiding E. coli DNA under a shipment labeled as underwear; the sender was Guangzhou Sci-Tech Innovation Trading. Investigations began November 2025 after the FBI found a March 2024 shipment to Xiang at his Bloomington residence. At Chicago O’Hare International Airport on Nov 23, 2025, he admitted the shipment was mislabeled to conceal the DNA and acknowledged a permit was required to ship biological materials to the U.S. He admitted that he and the shippers sought to evade U.S. law; CBP terminated his visa and he was arrested. E. coli is a common model organism used to study genetics.

article.articleHeadline: Vírus sincicial também traz risco para idosos, alertam especialistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory syncytial virus also poses a risk to the elderly, experts warn.
article.articleSummary: RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) poses a substantial, underrecognized risk to older adults in Brazil. First-quarter data show 27,6 thousand SRAG cases, with only 9,079 (33%) having the causative virus identified and nearly 17% not tested, highlighting limited RSV testing that expanded during the COVID-19 era. Among 1,651 severe RSV infections from January to March, 1,342 occurred in children under 2, while only 46 were confirmed in adults over 50. Total deaths this year reach 27, with 17 in infants up to 2 years and seven in seniors 65+. In the elderly, RSV infection increases pneumonia risk by about 2.7× and doubles the risk of ICU admission, intubation, and death compared with influenza. Vaccination for adults remains largely in private networks; SUS offers vaccination only to pregnant women to protect newborns. Medical societies recommend vaccines for those 50–69 with comorbidities and all adults 70+. Details from UFSC’s Rosemeri Maurici and an accompanying São Paulo seminar, with GSK involvement.

article.articleHeadline: Com 308 novos casos em uma semana, MS entra em nível de alerta para dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 308 new cases in one week, Mato Grosso do Sul enters dengue alert level.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports a dengue surge with 308 probable cases in the past week, bringing 2026 total to 2,793 and a 101.3 per 100,000 incidence. Ten municipalities exceed 300 per 100,000: Corumbá (681, 707.4), Costa Rica (155, 595.3), Amambai (223, 567.1), Douradina (31, 555.8), Sete Quedas (50, 454.8), Selvíria (34, 417.6), Santa Rita do Pardo (28, 398.5), Paraíso das Águas (20, 363.0), Itaporã (79, 327.3), Jardim (73, 304.4). In the last 14 days, Douradina and Amambai show sharp growth; Corguinho, Nova Alvorada do Sul, Tacuru had no dengue cases this year. One death under investigation was ruled out for another cause. Chikungunya shows 4,281 probable cases, 2,102 confirmed, 2,179 under investigation; 10 chikungunya deaths (Dourados 6, Bonito 1, Jardim 2, Fátima do Sul 1). Seventeen cities are in an epidemic; prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water and breeding sites.

article.articleHeadline: 研究调查742名感染艾滋病人士，发现：患艾滋病的人，有5大共性_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study surveying 742 AIDS patients found that people with AIDS share five common characteristics.
article.articleSummary: 742 people living with AIDS were studied, revealing five shared risk-related characteristics. First, unprotected sexual activity—both heterosexual and homosexual—allows mucosal entry of the virus. Second, having multiple sexual partners increases exposure. Third, unsafe blood exposure, such as sharing unsterilized needles or contaminated products, facilitates transmission. Fourth, lack of prevention knowledge leaves individuals unaware of transmission routes and protective measures. Fifth, optimistic bias or complacency, thinking 'one time won’t hurt,' increases vulnerability. The article notes that casual contacts (handshakes, hugs, meals) do not spread HIV; symptoms may be absent early, yet infectious. It highlights a trend toward younger affected groups and emphasizes non-discrimination and proactive prevention: regular testing after high-risk behavior, single partners, avoiding shared items, prompt counseling and intervention if exposure occurs. References include China CDC transmission guidance, CCTV prevention piece, and Mooc’s prevention manual.

The initiative follows a period of high dengue and chikungunya reports in the city, underscoring ongoing efforts to reduce transmission. This is part of intensified vector-control measures against Aedes aegypti.

article.articleHeadline: Báo động ca tử vong do dại tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies deaths on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths rise in Vietnam as prolonged heat increases dog bites. Tay Ninh Province has recorded seven rabies-related deaths in 2026 so far, including one from a stray dog and six from pet or familiar dogs. In Ho Chi Minh City, Pasteur Institute and HCDC report a fatal rabies case in Long Hai, Ba Ria-Vung Tau, involving a 63-year-old man (H.M.D.) bitten on January 13 who delayed advanced care and died after about a month. The surge aligns with more bites during the warm season; dog/cat vaccination coverage remains below 50% as of October 2025, with rural areas lagging. In Q1 2026, Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City vaccinated about 2,200–2,500 people per month for rabies, with 300–500 needing rabies immunoglobulin; immunoglobulin demand up ~30%. First-aid guidance emphasizes washing wounds for 15 minutes and seeking prompt medical care; avoid self-treatment. Vietnam spends over 1 trillion VND annually on rabies vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: Marine Virus Jumps to Humans Causing Permanent Eye Damage - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: CMNV (covert mortality nodavirus), a small RNA virus long circulating in marine life, has crossed to humans, causing persistent ocular hypertensive viral anterior uveitis (POH-VAU). In China, a study of 70 patients diagnosed between January 2022 and April 2025 found all tested positive for CMNV in ocular tissues. The condition presents with inflammation and elevated intraocular pressure; glaucoma-like optic nerve damage can lead to permanent vision loss, with about one-third requiring surgery and one patient experiencing irreversible vision loss. CMNV is known to infect farmed shrimp and gobies (Mugilogobius abei); zebrafish models show retinal/ocular pathology. Transmission routes include exposure to aquatic animals or raw seafood; possible human-to-human transmission is suggested. Discovery, published in Nature Microbiology, marks the first aquatic pathogen linked to a human ocular disease and raises questions about cross-species viral jumps and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 海洋ウイルスがヒトに感染し永続的な眼損傷を引き起こす

triage.notes: CMNV（偽秘密結節症ノダウイルス）は海洋生物に長年循環していた既知病原体だが、ヒトへの感染は初めて報告される。中国で2022年1月～2025年4月に診断された70例すべてが眼組織からCMNV陽性。失明を含む重篤な合併症（約1/3が手術要、1例は不可逆的失明）を伴う。水産動物の生食やダイレクト接触による曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が示唆されており、水産業従事者や沿岸地域における拡大リスクが懸念される。Nature Microbiologyに掲載された学術的重要性も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Exame de sangue e IA abrem caminho para diagnóstico precoce da hanseníase  - Diário do Grande ABC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Blood test and AI pave the way for early diagnosis of leprosy - Diário do Grande ABC
article.articleSummary: Blood test combined with a standard questionnaire and an artificial intelligence tool enables early diagnosis of Hansen’s disease (leprosy) in Brazil. Researchers from the University of São Paulo (FMRP-USP, Ribeirão Preto) analyzed blood samples from participants in a population COVID-19 survey; among ~700 invited, 224 agreed to participate, 195 provided blood samples, and 37 attended in-person clinical assessments. From these, 12 new leprosy cases were diagnosed, about one third of those evaluated. When laboratory data were integrated with the AI tool, the method reached 100% sensitivity for signaling suspected cases later confirmed at the clinical visit. A georeferential analysis mapped the spatial distribution of identified cases. Next steps include broader validation and integration into Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS) and primary care. The study highlights limitations of conventional tests for early detection and aims to enable earlier intervention and control.

article.articleHeadline: TB deaths in Gujarat: HIV in big chunk of cases
article.articleSummary: TB deaths in Gujarat show alarming early mortality: about 52% of TB patients died at home, and 59% died within 30 days of detection (AMC 2025 data), with deaths occurring soon after diagnosis. GMERS Valsad analysis of 4,795 patients via Nikshay surveillance reports a 3.9% mortality; among deaths, 22% had HIV infection and 23.5% had hypertension. Common symptoms include incessant cough, chest pain, shortness of breath, and hemoptysis. Low BMI is a major factor, with comorbid diabetes and tobacco/alcohol addictions noted. Gujarat recorded 1.3 lakh new TB cases in 2025, of which about 1.2 lakh recovered. The state marks TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan’s 100-day drive. Nationally, the Global TB Report 2025 notes a 21% decline in incidence in India from 2015 to 2024 and a 28% drop in TB deaths. Experts urge sustained screening, especially among workers in unorganized sectors to combat late detection.

triage.notes: 記事はインド（グジャラート州）での結核とHIV合併感染による異常な早期死亡率を報告。グジャラート州は2025年に13万件の新規TB患者を記録し、死亡率3.9%の中で22%がHIV陽性という深刻な状況。低BMI、糖尿病、タバコ/アルコール依存症が共存疾患として指摘されている。国家レベルでTB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan（TB撲滅運動）が展開中であり、非公式部門労働者を含む積極的スクリーニングが推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: [Kolom Pakar] Prof Tjandra Yoga Aditama: TB di Pasar Senen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Expert Column] Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama: Tuberculosis at Pasar Senen.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) outreach held on 11 April 2026 at the RPTRA Pasar Senen in Jakarta, led by Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama and organized by AMSA from the Faculty of Medicine, University of Indonesia (FKUI). The event, in a densely populated area, addressed five core topics: TB causes and transmission; detection and diagnosis; anti-TB drugs—types, treatment duration, and patient adherence; anti-TB drug resistance (OAT); and the critical role of community involvement in TB control. Participants ranged from children to an 88-year-old active grandmother. Questions included why handwashing wasn’t covered, vaccine effectiveness, and diet for TB patients, signaling grassroots concerns. The session underscores ongoing community-based TB education as foundational for Indonesia’s TB control, emphasizing sustained grassroots engagement to improve case finding, treatment adherence, and resistance prevention. Keywords: TB, Indonesia, Pasar Senen, public health, community engagement.

article.articleHeadline: Health ministry declares measles outbreak in seven S. Sulawesi regions - Archipelago - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared as KLB in seven regions of South Sulawesi, Indonesia: Makassar (provincial capital) and the regencies of Luwu, Wajo, Sinjai, Bulukumba, Jeneponto and East Luwu. The Health Ministry issued a circular to conduct disease mapping amid a national measles outbreak; the seven areas designated as KLB though status was declared by each city/regency. As of 8 April 2026, South Sulawesi provincial agency reported 169 laboratory-confirmed measles cases in children. Measles, a viral respiratory illness, has been increasing since 2025 through March 2026. Earlier in December 2025, cases spread in three regencies and were initially classified as suspect; lab confirmation converted many to positive cases. Preventive measures have been ongoing since suspect detections. The designation indicates an extraordinary public health event requiring enhanced surveillance and outbreak response.

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ dịch sốt xuất huyết bùng phát kỷ lục trong năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Risk of a record-breaking dengue fever outbreak in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever faces record outbreak risk in 2026 due to climate change and El Niño. Transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, it rose from about 500,000 cases in 2000 to over 14 million in 2024, with roughly 10,000 deaths. The WHO classifies dengue as a neglected tropical disease. El Niño projections show 62% probability from June–August, up to 80% in autumn; past events (2015–2016, 2023–2024) added 4.1 million and 9.6 million cases. At a Lyon summit, Jarbas Barbosa warns dengue now signals broader environmental health threats. Kenya joined a Dengue Alliance with Thailand, India, Malaysia and Brazil, backed by about €20 million EU funding. About 13 treatments are in development; Butantan licensed a vaccine with 80.5% protection against hospitalization for at least five years; Takeda’s Qdenga is approved in Europe but not in the US. Wolbachia-based mosquito control is deployed in Brazil and Peru to protect over 140 million people over 10 years.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：2026年にデング熱の記録破りの流行リスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数対象国での流行懸念、気候変動要因、国際的な対策枠組み構築に伴う高い社会的・政治的関心。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは複数国のデング熱リスクについて言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazil、Thailand、Indiaの3国。Lyonはフランスの都市で対象国外のため除外。El Niño予測、気候変動、ワクチン開発、Wolbachia蚊制御などの広域的な対策枠組みが構築されており、国際的な関心が高い。Kenya、Peru、Malaysiaは記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：百日咳绝非"只是咳得久一点"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: Pertussis is by no means 'just a longer-lasting cough'.
article.articleSummary: Pertussis is a life-threatening infection for young infants, not merely a longer cough, per a National Health Commission briefing cited by China CDC researcher Zheng Hui. In infants, disease often presents atypically with paroxysmal dyspnea, cyanosis, or apnea, especially at night, delaying treatment. Complications include hypoxia leading to pertussis encephalopathy and severe pneumonia; critical cases can be fatal and survivors may have lasting sequelae. Prevention centers on vaccination: in December 2024, five departments updated the National Immunization Program to a five-dose DTaP schedule nationwide from January 1, 2025—administered at 2, 4, 6 months, 18 months, and 6 years—providing earlier and longer protection. Parents should ensure complete immunization and maintain household hygiene and ventilation; if a family member has a cough, use masks, and during peak respiratory season avoid crowded public places to protect infants.

triage.notes: 記事は百日咳の疾病負荷と重症度（乳幼児の死亡・神経障害の可能性）を強調し、2025年1月からの全国予防接種プログラム更新（5回接種スケジュール）を発表する公式ガイダンスです。感染症アウトブレイクの報告というより、既知疾病に対する予防戦略の強化が主体であるため、直ちにRRAへ進む段階ではありませんが、今後の中国内の百日咳発生動向に関する続報を注視する価値があります。

article.articleHeadline: Dept issues food safety warning
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Health Department warns of heightened food-poisoning risk during Songkran as extreme heat accelerates bacterial growth. Health Department director-general Amporn Benjaponpitak said hot weather during Songkran creates favourable conditions for harmful microorganisms, particularly Vibrio parahaemolyticus, commonly found in seafood, to multiply rapidly. From Jan 1 to March 14, 2026, more than 37,800 cumulative food-poisoning cases have been recorded, with numbers rising since late January as temperatures climbed. Other pathogens—Salmonella and Staphylococcus aureus—are major causes of diarrhoea, vomiting and acute illness during this period. The warning highlights heightened vigilance for food safety during the holiday in Thailand, as seafood and other foods pose elevated risks in high heat.

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局发布通知推进重点虫媒传染病防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention Issues Notice to Advance Prevention and Control of Priority Vector-borne Infectious Diseases
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-10, China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention issued a notice to依法做好重点虫媒传染病防控工作 and released the 2026 prevention plans for dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). The document mandates a 'One Health' human–animal–environment surveillance system spanning monitoring, early warning, prevention/intervention, emergency response, disease management, and enforcement to curb multiple vector-borne diseases. The strategy prioritizes environmental management as the core, with biological and physical controls and chemical measures when needed; high-incidence areas should bolster cross-sector coordination and sanitation to close gaps. It strengthens port/public health cooperation for imported cases and point-to-point control, and enforces the 'four early' approach with frontline training; fever clinics should remain open during transmission seasons, and fevers in suspected outbreaks should be tested. From 2026-04-01, chikungunya and SFTS become Category B infectious diseases in China, with corresponding controls. Dengue/chikungunya rely on vector control; SFTS prevention targets tick bites. Suspected cases should report travel, tick exposure, outdoor activity, or animal contact within two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局が重点虫媒伝染病の防御推進に関する通知を発表

triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、中国国家疾病管理センターによる公式な予防管理計画の発表である。デング熱、チクングニア、SFTSの3疾患が対象。スクリーニング基準のうち長期曝露リスク（ベクター媒介、季節的伝播）と流行しやすさ（ベクター密度、屋外活動）が該当。ただし現在の流行規模、患者数、重症度に関する具体的データが不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。政府レベルの関心は明らかに高い。

article.articleHeadline: 食品饮料行业周报：口蹄疫催化原奶周期拐点，啤酒板...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food and Beverage Industry Weekly: Foot-and-Mouth Disease Catalyzes the Turning Point in the Raw Milk Cycle, Beer Sector...
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease SAT1 outbreak confirmed in China, imported from South Africa; localized with limited culling, no systemic disruption to national dairy or beef supply, but dairy cow milk yield may decline. Enhanced biosecurity, restocking, and transport controls could tighten near-term raw milk supply, accelerating the milk-price cycle bottom and signaling a rebound in 2026. Favor large, biosecure dairy operations: YouRan Dairy, Modern Dairy, China Saint Dairy; potential upside for leading players Yili and Mengniu as the cycle turns. Beer sector: 2025 Q2 ban constrained beer sales; 2026 El Niño may bring sustained heat, lifting beer demand, with World Cup 2026 (US-Canada-Mexico) boosting seasonality. Preferred beer names: Qingdao Beer, China Resources Beer, Chongqing Beer. Portfolio ideas: Kweichow Moutai, Ximai Foods, Haitian Flavouring, Ganyuan Foods.

article.articleHeadline: Vaksinasi Massal di Mendoyo Bali, Pemerintah Terjunkan Enam Tim Geruduk Wilayah Zona Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass Vaccination in Mendoyo, Bali, Government Deploys Six Teams to Raid the Rabies Zone.
article.articleSummary: Mass rabies vaccination begins in Jembrana, Bali, on April 13, 2026, as six teams are deployed to curb the outbreak. The program targets red-zone districts—notably Mendoyo—and coastal areas of Gumi Makepung, suspected as dumping grounds for rabies-infected animals (HPR) such as dogs and cats. As of April 2026, 21 animals tested positive for rabies across districts, with Mendoyo reporting the highest caseload. In March–April, six new animal rabies cases were recorded: Pekutatan (1), Melaya (1), Mendoyo (2), Negara (2). Six teams are dispatched: four external teams and two regular veterinary teams. External teams focus on red zones; regular teams operate in areas with lower vaccination coverage. Vaccinations will also target vulnerable coastal zones like Pohsanten and Penyaringan. Authorities urge community participation to reduce transmission and prevent further cases.

triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（バリ州ジェンブラナ地区）における動物狂犬病の流行と政府による大規模予防接種キャンペーンを報告。4月時点で21動物が陽性確認され、メンドヨが最多症例。ヒト感染例や死亡例の記載はなく、重症度およびヒト健康への具体的影響は不明。動物→ヒト感染のリスク管理状況も不明なため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Cholera outbreak 2026 - DREF Operation (MDRCG028) - Congo
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Republic of Congo continues after a July 2025 start, with ongoing transmission and a high case fatality rate (8.5%), well above the emergency threshold. As of 26 March 2026, cumulative totals reach 1,074 cases (998 suspected, 76 confirmed) and 91 deaths. During 12–26 March 2026, 33 new suspected cases and 4 deaths were recorded, indicating resurgence and not yet under control. Affected departments include Congo-Oubangui (Mossaka-Loukolela most affected), Brazzaville (Île Mbamou, Talangaï), Likouala, and Nkeni-Alima; recent activity is reported in Mossaka (16 cases, 4 deaths) and Île Mbamou (17 cases). The outbreak is compounded by high community deaths and persistent transmission amid inadequate WASH conditions, underscoring urgent need for intervention to reduce mortality and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国のコレラ流行2026 - DREF オペレーション（MDRCG028）
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行が継続中で高い致命率（8.5%）、累積1,074例91死亡、3月中の新規症例報告あり。IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにDRC（GeoNames ID 203312）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ共和国（Republic of Congo）での流行を主題としている。コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCも記事サマリーでは主な発生地として言及されていないため除外。ただし地理的近接性により後続のRRAで境界地域への拡大リスクを検討すること。

article.articleHeadline: Rat hepatitis E virus may be a hidden cause of hepatitis in humans
article.articleSummary: Rat hepatitis E virus (ratHEV, Rocahepevirus ratti) is increasingly recognized as a zoonotic cause of hepatitis in humans. A Nature Communications review summarizes ratHEV ecology, host range, virology, and clinical impact after the first human infection in Hong Kong; since then cases have been reported across Asia, Europe, and Canada, with most infections in China and Spain and sporadic cases in France, Canada, Germany, and Thailand. ratHEV circulates in synanthropic rats; RNA prevalence in trapped rats is 10–30%, higher in urban and subtropical Asia and southern Europe. Genotypes C1–C5 exist; C1 carries zoonotic potential, while C2–C5 appear to have limited zoonosis. Domestic pigs can transiently harbor ratHEV; serology shows exposure in Asia and Europe. Diagnosis relies on viral RNA by qPCR; antibody assays show cross-reactivity and limited utility. Clinically, ratHEV can range from subclinical hepatitis to fulminant liver failure, with chronic hepatitis in immunocompromised individuals; encephalitis reported. Limited assays imply an underestimated global burden.

triage.headline_ja: ラット肝炎Eウイルスがヒトの肝炎の隠れた原因となる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 新興人獣共通感染症として多くの症例報告があり、複数国での国際的な地理的拡大、重症度（劇症肝不全や脳炎も報告）、診断キットの不足による認識不足が確認される。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はラット肝炎Eウイルスの人獣共通感染症としての国際的拡大を報告。アジア（中国、タイが主）、ヨーロッパ（スペイン、フランス、ドイツ）、カナダでの発症が記載されているが、対象国リスト内での確認は中国とタイ。香港は中国に含める。診断キット不足による過小評価の懸念があり、ハイリスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: 孕妇吃冰箱剩菜后不幸离世，竟是因为这种细菌......
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A pregnant woman who ate fridge leftovers unfortunately died, and it turned out to be caused by this type of bacteria...
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-13, a 35-year-old pregnant woman in Zhengzhou, Henan, China died after eating fridge leftovers, despite three months of aggressive treatment. The death was caused by Listeria monocytogenes infection, a bacterium nicknamed the 'fridge killer' because it can grow at refrigeration temperatures. Listeria can survive down to -1.5°C and may incubate for 3 weeks to over 2 months. High-risk groups include pregnant women, newborns, people aged 65+, and the immunocompromised; in pregnancy, maternal infection can cross the placenta, causing miscarriage, stillbirth, or severe neonatal illness, even if the mother has mild symptoms. Common sources include unpasteurized dairy, salads, unwashed vegetables, deli meats and pre-cut fruits, and it can persist in vacuum-packed foods. Prevention emphasizes: fridge ≤4°C, freezer ≤-18°C; thorough cleaning; separate storage of raw and cooked foods; reheat leftovers to ≥74°C; consume perishables within 3 days; wash hands and utensils after handling raw foods; strict hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 妊婦が冷蔵庫の残り物を食べた後、不幸にも死亡。その原因はこのバクテリアだった...
triage.triage_reason: リステリア・モノサイトゲネス感染による妊婦死亡という重症事例。公衆衛生への重大な影響と予想外性があり、食品安全を含む広域的リスク認識が高く、社会的関心が見込まれる。
triage.notes: リステリア・モノサイトゲネスは妊婦・新生児・高齢者・免疫不全者の脆弱集団に重大リスク。冷蔵保管中も増殖可能な環境細菌で、食品安全に関する広範なリスクを示唆。死亡事例であり重症度は高いが、現時点での疫学的拡大情報は記事に記載されていない。中国における食品安全管理の啓発効果として社会政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: RSUD Karanganyar Siapkan Ruang Isolasi Bagi Pasien Campak dengan Komplikasi - Suara Merdeka Solo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Karanganyar Regional General Hospital Prepares Isolation Room for Measles Patients with Complications - Suara Merdeka Solo
article.articleSummary: As of 13 April 2026, RSUD Kartini Karanganyar in Karanganyar prepares an 11-bed isolation room for measles (campak) patients with complications, following reports of measles at local Puskesmas. No measles patients are currently hospitalized at RSUD Kartini. About eight measles cases have been found in the district, with severe cases typically referred to hospital if high fever and seizures occur. The isolation room, SOP-compliant, aims to prevent mixing measles patients with general patients and to protect healthcare workers from infection. The hospital continues close monitoring and coordination with the Health Department on the outbreak's spread and will treat any severe cases according to procedures. Preparedness focuses on safe management of suspected complications and safeguarding staff while the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: カランガニャル地域総合病院が合併症を伴う麻疹患者のための隔離室を準備 - スアラ・メルデカ・ソロ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・中部ジャワ州で麻疹の小規模集団発生（約8症例）が報告されており、スクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、長期曝露の可能性、流行しやすさ）。ただし現在のところ入院患者なし、死亡報告なく、情報不足のため段階的な経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、カランガニャル県（中部ジャワ州、インドネシア）で麻疹の小規模集団発生が報告されている。現在のところ重症例や死亡の明確な報告はなく、病院による準備段階。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染が容易であり、予防接種率やコミュニティの免疫状況について情報不足。政府機関（保健局）との連携が確認されているが、国際的拡大リスクについては記事に記載がない。
