article.articleHeadline: 4月流感回升，湖南疾控支招防护_科教.文卫_湖南频道
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza resurges in April; Hunan CDC offers protection guidance.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity resurges in April in Hunan Province, China, with national surveillance showing rising flu positivity. Circulating strains are mainly Influenza B (BV), while Influenza A(H3N2) has declined. Weather fluctuations, high humidity, and increased mobility are linked to renewed transmission. BV infections commonly cause fever, headache, fatigue, and myalgia, and may include gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea and vomiting, especially in children. Vaccination remains the primary prevention for everyone aged six months and older, prioritizing the elderly, children, pregnant women, chronic disease patients, and healthcare workers. Additional measures include mask use, hand hygiene, and indoor ventilation; avoid crowds. Antiviral treatment within 48 hours can shorten illness and reduce severe outcomes; seek care for persistent fever or respiratory distress. Target protections for school-aged children, pregnant women, older adults, and high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 4月にインフルエンザが再燃、湖南疾病対策センターが予防対策を提示
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザBが湖南省で再燃しており複数のWPRO基準に該当するが、公衆衛生的な深刻度や異常性の詳細が不明であり、IHR基準は明確に2つ以上該当する証拠に欠ける。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 湖南省で季節的なインフルエンザの再燃が報告されており、当局による予防ガイダンスが提示されている。BV型が優勢で、天候変動と高湿度が伝播に関連している。死亡例や重症例の数については記事に記載されていない。中国国内での対応状況も不明であり、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Relocating infectious disease clinics may delay epidemic response, expert warns
article.articleSummary: By 2035 Hanoi’s Capital Master Plan proposes relocating high-risk infectious disease facilities from the inner city. Dat of Hanoi Medical University argues this would delay epidemic response. He cites SARS (2003) treated in-city at the Institute of Clinical Medicine for Tropical Diseases (78 Giai Phong Street) with no hospital-acquired spread, and COVID-19 illustrating the need for on-site treatment. Concentrating cases in central facilities with negative-pressure isolation rooms enables rapid care and lowers mortality, he says; relocating could cause silent transmission and late outbreak detection. In developed nations, city-center units exist (e.g., Tokyo’s Japan Institute for Health Security; Berlin’s Charité) to maintain readiness. Hanoi’s dense population and dengue, hand-foot-mouth, measles, and influenza pressures support on-site management. Dat proposes strengthening general-hospital infectious-disease departments and creating city-based specialized facilities with modern isolation rooms, plus four new hospitals by 2035: two regional general hospitals (500 beds each), Hanoi Geriatric (250) and Hanoi Endocrine (250).

triage.headline_ja: 感染症クリニックの移転は流行対応の遅延を招く可能性、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はハノイの感染症クリニック施設の移転計画に関する政策議論であり、現在進行中の感染症の流行やアウトブレイク報告ではない。複数の病名が言及されているが、いずれも歴史的事例または一般的な疾病負担の文脈である。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイの都市マスタープラン2035における感染症施設の移転に関する専門家の警告であり、現在のアウトブレイク報告ではない。SARS(2003)およびCOVID-19は歴史的文脈として言及されているのみ。記事で列挙されている複数の病名（COVID-19、麻疹、インフルエンザ、EV71、デング）はハノイの一般的な疾病負担を示す例示であり、特定のシグナルイベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: 全国流感病毒检测阳性率连续3周上升，主要流行毒株有变化
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide influenza virus test positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks, and the dominant circulating strains have changed.
article.articleSummary: China’s national sentinel surveillance for acute respiratory infections shows influenza virus positive test rates rising for three consecutive weeks, with northern provinces exhibiting higher positivity than southern ones. The surge is driven mainly by influenza B activity, per Li Tongzeng, chief physician in the Infectious Disease Department at Beijing You An Hospital. The last influenza B peak occurred December 2023–January 2024, more than two years ago, with waning population immunity to B and recent temperature fluctuations potentially contributing. Influenza typically peaks in winter–spring (November through February–March), and this cycle has seen a shift from previously circulating influenza A strains to influenza B. Symptoms mirror A-type infections: fever, cough, sore throat, myalgia; children show higher rates of vomiting and diarrhea than adults. Antiviral treatment within 48 hours—oseltamivir, peramivir, baloxavir marboxil—can reduce severe outcomes and shorten illness. Priority protection for the elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 全国流感病毒検査陽性率が連続3週間上昇、主流循環株に変化
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザB型の活動増加が報告され、異常性（2年以上ぶりの大規模流行）とWPRO基準複数該当が認められるが、深刻度や国際拡大リスクの情報が限定的であり、フルRRA前の追加情報監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザB型の異常な活動増加（2年以上ぶりの大規模流行）を報告しており、WPRO基準の異常性・流行易易性・継続的曝露に該当。ただし重症度（入院・死亡数）や国際拡大リスクについては明示されていない。中国での公衆衛生監視情報であり政府関心は高いと推測されるが、地域限定的（北部が高い）である点も考慮。追加情報（重症患者数、死亡確認、医療負荷など）の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe avança antes do inverno e número de casos quase dobra no Brasil em 2026; médico infectologista recomenda prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza advances ahead of winter and the number of cases nearly doubles in Brazil in 2026; an infectious disease specialist recommends prevention.
article.articleSummary: Influenza season in Brazil started earlier and more intensely in 2026, with influenza-associated severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) nearly doubling from January to mid-March (3,584 cases in 2026 vs 1,838 in 2025). Across the period, more than 800 deaths from respiratory viruses were reported, and total SARI cases reached about 14,000 by mid-March (Instituto Todos pela Saúde; Ministry of Health data). Climate factors—prolonged rainfall and temperature variations—are cited as aiding transmission, especially in enclosed, poorly ventilated spaces. Infectologist Dr. Arlindo Schiesari Junior, coordinator of the Hospital Infection Control Commission at Hospital Padre Albino, urges continued prevention: frequent hand hygiene, well-ventilated environments, and avoiding crowds. Vaccination remains the main strategy; the national campaign runs through May 30, aiming to immunize 90% of priority groups. About 6 million doses have been administered; free vaccination is available at health posts for children, the elderly, pregnant people, health workers, teachers, Indigenous peoples, and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで冬前にインフルエンザが拡大し、2026年の症例数がほぼ倍増。感染症専門医が予防を推奨
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI）の倍増、800人以上の死亡）と異常な流行パターン（季節外れ、強度の増加）を認める。WPRO基準では重症度が高く、長期曝露・流行性が認められる。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2026年1月～3月中旬のインフルエンザ関連SARI症例が前年同期比でほぼ倍増（3,584 vs 1,838）。800人以上の呼吸器ウイルス関連死亡が報告されている。気候要因（降雨と気温変動）が伝播を促進している可能性がある。ブラジル保健省による全国ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 蚊子早醒暴增？实为越冬蚊复苏
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquitoes wake up early? It's actually the revival of overwintering mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Early 2026: Shandong Province, China, reports an early rise in overwintering mosquitoes in March, but overall vector density remains low; bite risk is heightened by rapid spring warming and urban breeding sites. Main local vectors are pale-colored mosquitoes (淡色库蚊), Aedes albopictus (white-striped/flower mosquito), and Culex tritaeniorhynchus (three-banded culicine). Aedes mosquitoes bite mainly by day; Culex at night. Dengue fever and chikungunya are imported from tropical regions; no local dengue or chikungunya cases in Shandong, and no related viruses detected in local mosquitoes. Japanese encephalitis virus circulates in a pig–mosquito–human cycle; risk higher near pig farms and rural areas. JE vaccine is part of routine childhood immunization; no full-population vaccines for dengue/chikungunya; yellow fever vaccine for travelers. Surveillance covers 16 cities with bi-monthly mosquito checks; some pyrethroid resistance noted; rotate insecticides. Public guidance: eliminate standing water, kill larvae, and bite protection.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊子早醒暴增？实为越冬蚊复苏（蚊が早く目覚める？実は越冬蚊の復活）
triage.triage_reason: 中国山東省における越冬蚊の早期復活報告だが、現在のところ局所的な媒介蚊密度の増加のみで、デング熱・チクングニア熱は輸入症例、日本脳炎も豚舎・農村地域の周辺に限定。重篤事例や国際的拡大リスク、管理困難性がなく、啓発記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 本記事は蚊媒介感染症の媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ、ヒトスジシマカ、コガタアカイエカ）の春季復活に関する啓発・予防ガイダンスであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。山東省での蚊密度増加は季節的変動の範囲内で、デング・チクングニアは輸入症例のみ、日本脳炎も局地的で既往ワクチン接種体制が機能している。監視体制も整備されており、管理困難性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova covid já está presente em pelo menos 23 países - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 is already present in at least 23 countries - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 BA.3.2 sublineage, descended from Omicron and first identified in November 2024, is detected in at least 23 countries per a CDC report cited by Jornal O Sul. The Global Virus Network noted on April 3 that it is monitoring the lineage; there is no evidence it increases disease severity. WHO says the sublineage is not a cause for alarm, and Brazil has no recorded cases yet. BA.3.2 bears many mutations, enabling partial immune escape and a higher risk of hospitalizations among older adults, the immunocompromised, and people with chronic conditions, though it is not more virulent. Experts call for updating vaccines to circulating strains with an annual reformulation. Boosters remain important: yearly dose for the general population, and every six months for those over 65. Brazil reports vaccine shipments; by April 6, over 4.1 million doses were sent to states via the PNI.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスが既に23カ国以上に広がっている - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新しい亜系統（BA.3.2）の国際的な広がりが報告されているが、WHOは懸念を示しておらず、重症度の増加も認められていない。ただし、国際的な検出と関心があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ該当（unusual_unexpected、international_spread）。WPRO基準は3つ該当（abnormal_unexpected、epidemic_prone、prolonged_exposure不明）。ただし、WHOが懸念を示さず重症度の増加が認められていないため、IHRの重要度基準（serious_impact）には該当しない。ブラジルではまだ確認事例がなく、国際的には23カ国で検出されているが、深刻な健康影響の報告がないため「WATCH」判定。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Merebak di Jawa Tengah, Sarif Ingatkan Pola Hidup Sehat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Spreads in Central Java, Sarif Reminds People to Live a Healthy Lifestyle.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Central Java, Indonesia, with 2,188 suspected cases reported as of 7 April across districts including Kudus (501), Brebes (202), Cilacap (119), Pati (72), and Klaten (54); laboratory-confirmed measles total 144 and rubella total 18. Among confirmed measles, Cilacap records 21 cases, Banyumas 20, Pati 20, and Klaten 6 (with 1 rubella in Klaten). Deputy Speaker Sarif Abdillah stresses healthy-lifestyle changes at the family level to bolster the health system and disease prevention. Immunization remains a mandatory national program implemented by local governments, with calls for intensified vaccination campaigns and early detection to curb the spread of measles and rubella.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹がジャワ中部で蔓延、サリフ健康的なライフスタイルを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の集団発生（2,188疑い症例、確定144件）で異常性・重症度が明らかであり、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。また政府指導者による公式声明が報道されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、発生地域の全地点（Brebes、Kudus、Banyumas、Pati、Klaten、Cilacap）はインドネシアのジャワ中部地域に位置する。麻疹は高い感染力を持ち、予防接種が有効な疫病予防可能疾患であるが、地域の免疫接種プログラムの強化が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Kusta di Karawang Meningkat, Anak-Anak Mulai Terdampak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hansen's disease cases in Karawang on the rise, children starting to be affected.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) cases in Karawang Regency, Purwasuka, are rising after 2024’s 168 cases, increasing to 226 in 2025. Notably, 15 children were diagnosed in 2025, indicating pediatric transmission. Local authorities consider this a serious concern and aim to curb spread in 2026. The principal strategy is strengthened early detection at primary care facilities: every Puskesmas (community health center) should actively monitor for leprosy signs, with district services conducting universal screening and offering free treatment to reduce transmission. Symptoms include skin patches that are white or red, non-itching, and numbness or sensory loss. Transmission occurs through respiratory droplets and prolonged close contact with an infected person. The article does not report laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases, but it notes ongoing stigma reduction and public education campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: カラワン県のハンセン病患者が増加、子どもたちも感染し始める
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのカラワン県でハンセン病患者が増加傾向にあり、特に小児患者の出現が懸念される。地域当局が深刻視しているものの、国際的拡大リスクや死亡者の報告がなく、情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は根治可能な感染症であり、死亡報告や重症例が記事に明記されていない。2024年168例から2025年226例への増加と小児患者（15例）の出現が異常性を示唆する。人-人感染の可能性（飛沫・長期接触）と継続的な曝露リスクがあるため、WPROスクリーニング基準で3項目該当。ただし国際的拡大リスクの具体的根拠がないため、PICKUPではなくWATCHと判定。地域での対応能力に関する情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: 深圳一男子被老鼠咬10天后确诊鼠咬热，鼠类可传播的疾病有哪些？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man in Shenzhen was diagnosed with rat-bite fever 10 days after being bitten by a rat; what diseases can rodents transmit?
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, Guangdong, a security guard developed rat-bite fever about 10 days after being bitten by a rat; laboratory diagnosis confirmed rat-bite fever caused by Streptobacillus moniliformis. The patient had a fever peaking at 40.2°C with chills and improved after antibiotic treatment. The article notes that not only wild rats but domestic hamsters and laboratory mice can carry this bacterium. Four major rodent-borne diseases are highlighted: hantavirus-caused hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome, plague (transmitted by rat fleas), leptospirosis from contaminated water or soil, and rat-bite fever. Preventive guidance includes four steps: seal food, destroy rodent nests, seal entry holes, and use safe physical traps for eradication; avoid toxic rodenticides and ensure proper storage of food. Personal protection and hygiene are emphasized; seek medical care promptly if high fever, bleeding tendencies, or lymphadenopathy occur after rodent exposure, especially in Guangdong.

triage.headline_ja: 深圳で男性がネズミに咬まれて10日後にネズミ咬傷熱と診断；ネズミが媒介する疾病には何があるか？
triage.triage_reason: 単一の確定症例（ネズミ咬傷熱）の報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。ただし、公開情報による啓発と複数の齧歯動物媒介疾病言及により、スクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当する可能性があるため経過観察継続を要する。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の確定症例（ネズミ咬傷熱）と予防啓発が主題。複数の齧歯動物媒介疾病（ハンタウイルス感染症、ペスト、レプトスピラ症、ネズミ咬傷熱）が言及されており、長期曝露リスク（ペット含むネズミとの接触機会の常在性）と流行しやすさ（ヒト-ネズミ接触、不十分な対策）の両基準に該当。ただし国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響の兆候なし。香港・マカオでないため China (1814991) のみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ciri-Ciri Anak Terkena Penyakit Campak : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Signs of Measles in Children: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Measles remains a contagious threat to Indonesian children, notably in Jakarta. The Indonesian Ministry of Health urges parents and teachers to keep students home when fever with cough is present to prevent transmission. Measles, caused by a virus, spreads quickly via saliva droplets emitted during coughing or sneezing, especially among those with incomplete immunization. Recognizing early signs is crucial; a key symptom is a sudden high fever above 38°C several days before the characteristic rash, with fever potentially lasting before rash appears. The article underscores vaccination but does not provide case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or current outbreak status, nor any imported/exported case information. Published on 2026-04-13.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の子どもへの兆候：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の流行可能性を示唆する情報があるが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、確認された症例数、または現在の流行状況に関する具体的なデータが記事に記載されていない。教育的記事である可能性が高く、感染症イベントの確認に必要な流行学的情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省が親と教職員に対して麻疹対策を促す啓発記事である。患者数、死亡数、実検査室確認数、現在の流行状況に関する具体的データが欠落している。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染性が高く、ワクチン接種率が不完全な集団では流行可能性があるが、本記事からは既知の流行の存在を確認することができない。続報で具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Encephalitis, Chandipura ruled out in Rajasthan's Salumber after 7 kids die
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan's Salumber district, Ghata village and nearby areas report seven child deaths between April 1–5 amid an encephalitis‑like illness. Tests on samples from 20 children were negative for Japanese encephalitis and Chandipura virus, easing outbreak fears; malaria-positive samples and cases of diarrhoea or other infections were also observed, while the exact cause remains unconfirmed. Symptoms included fever and convulsions. Deaths occurred: five at home or en route to hospital, one after being taken home against medical advice, and one at RNT Medical College in Udaipur. Health officials blame delays in seeking care on quack practices; authorities launched anti-quackery campaigns, awareness drives, and anti-mosquito measures in affected villages. Over 10 days, 6,233 health teams surveyed 114,773 houses, finding 1,162 with fever/vomiting/cold; 81 referred to hospitals and 1,005 given first aid. Anti-mosquito activities conducted at 6,352 locations.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州サルンバーで7人の子どもが死亡、脳炎とチャンディプラウイルスは除外
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：7人の小児死亡、異常性：原因不明、国際拡大リスク：蚊媒介性疾患）。WPROスクリーニングで重症度・異常性・流行しやすさが確認され、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 原因未確定の小児脳炎様疾患による多数死亡は重大なシグナル。日本脳炎・チャンディプラウイルスが除外されたものの、マラリア陽性例も確認され、多病因性の可能性がある。ラジャスタン州当局が積極的な疫学調査と対策（蚊媒介対策、啓発活動）を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand warns of food poisoning risks as Songkran heat fuels bacterial surge - Pattaya Mail
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Health warns during Songkran that extreme heat accelerates bacterial growth, elevating food-poisoning risk in Bangkok and nationwide. Pathogens highlighted include Vibrio parahaemolyticus in seafood, Salmonella in raw poultry, pork, unpasteurized milk and unwashed produce, and Staphylococcus aureus from food handlers with poor hygiene. Data from early 2025 show more than 37,831 food-poisoning cases from January to mid-March, with numbers rising in hot weather. Officials advise cooking foods to at least 70°C for 2 minutes, ensuring heat reaches the center, and continuing to cook shellfish after shells open. Avoid raw or undercooked seafood and pickled items. Buy ingredients from cold-chain-sustaining sources, and reheat prepared foods left at room temperature for more than 2 hours. Use separate utensils, follow Eat Hot, Use Serving Spoons, and Wash Hands, and seek medical care or ORS for severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ソンクラーン期間の熱により細菌が増殖、タイが食中毒リスクに警告
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の季節的増加に関する公衆衛生警告であり、異常な疾患発生ではなく既知の環境要因による予防啓発。IHR基準に該当するほどのシグナルではないが、食中毒症例数の上昇傾向から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: タイの保健部門による季節的食中毒リスク警告。ソンクラーン期間中の気温上昇に伴う細菌増殖が主因であり、既知の環境要因による予防措置。2025年1月中旬から3月中旬までの37,831件の食中毒症例は統計的増加に該当するが、新規疾患や異常な病原体ではない。スクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、公式な予防啓発活動であるため管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: BRIN Ingatkan Potensi Kembalinya Wabah Pes di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN Warns of the Potential Return of the Plague Outbreak in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) remains enzootic in parts of Indonesia, posing ongoing human outbreak risk despite no human cases for over a decade. Fleas on rats harbor the bacterium, with Java’s Pasuruan Regency, Boyolali, Sleman, and Bandung identified as focus areas. BRIN researchers warn of a silent period—undetected circulation that could reemerge—driven by deforestation, land-use change, population growth, and climate-driven shifts in flea vectors. Transmission to humans occurs via bites from infected fleas on rats. The team calls for strengthened integrated surveillance across humans, animals, and vectors, better environmental sanitation, and monitoring of former endemic zones. Findings come from the Environmental Changes and Risk of Plague Epidemics in Indonesia, a BRIN–Ministry of Health collaboration with Chinese and French partners.

triage.headline_ja: BRINインドネシアのペスト（黒死病）流行の潜在的復活の可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: ペストは異常・予想外の再発リスク（10年以上の人感染なし後の潜在的再興）を示し、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、公式な学術機関（BRIN）による警告と国際的な学術協力が存在するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ペストは高致死率の感染症であり、10年以上の人感染報告がない中での再発リスク警告は公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。BRIN（インドネシア科学院）が正式に警告を発し、中国・フランス等の国際的なパートナーシップに基づく研究である。Java地域（Pasuruan, Boyolali, Sleman, Bandung）が特定されており、土地利用変化・森林破壊・気候変動がベクター（ネズミノミ）の動態に影響を与えるという科学的根拠がある。統合サーベイランスの強化を要する警告との内容から、ピックアップして詳細なRRA実施が適切。

article.articleHeadline: കോട്ടയത്ത്‌ വീണ്ടും ആശങ്കയായി പക്ഷിപ്പനി; 6500ഓളം വളര്‍ത്തുപക്ഷികളെ നശിപ്പിക്കും, പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ച സാഹചര്യത്തില്‍ പൊതുജനങ്ങള്‍ ജാഗ്രത പാലിക്കണമെന്ന്‌ ജില്ലാ മൃഗസംരക്ഷണ ഓഫീസർ ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza a concern again in Kottayam; around 6,500 farmed birds to be culled; District Animal Husbandry Officer urges the public to stay vigilant if avian influenza is confirmed ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) confirmed in Kottayam district, Kerala, as of 13 April 2026, at Udayanapuram panchayat’s Ward 16. A PD Joannin-owned farm in Puthankar reported about 1,200 dead chickens; infection confirmed by testing. Authorities will cull about 6,500 birds across three nearby farms. A 1-kilometre infected zone and a 10-kilometre surveillance zone have been declared. Public urged to stay vigilant, report abnormal poultry mortality to the nearest veterinary hospital, and follow safety measures (masks, gloves) when handling dead birds. Three-day ban on movement of poultry, eggs, meat, and litter within and around the affected area; three-month ban on bringing poultry, eggs, meat, or litter into or out of the surveillance zone. Earlier outbreaks include Alappuzha Muhamma (6,000 birds culled) and February cases in Kottayam city wards 37–38; migratory birds are implicated.

triage.headline_ja: コッタヤムでも鳥インフルエンザが懸念される；約6,500羽の飼育鳥が殺処分される；鳥インフルエンザが確認された状況で一般市民は警戒を呼びかけられている
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザがインドで確認され、IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生地域、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。ヒト感染への懸念がある新興感染症シグナル。
triage.notes: H5N1はヒト-ヒト感染ポテンシャルが高く、既に複数地域での反復的な発生が報告されている（Alappuzha、Kottayam市部、現在のUdayanapuram）。渡航制限の可能性あり。ただし現段階では動物由来（家禽・野鳥）の確認のみで、ヒト感染例は記事に記載されていない。全インド規模での拡大監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bacolod leptospirosis cases up by 200%
article.articleSummary: Bacolod City reports a 200% rise in leptospirosis from January to April 4, 2026, with 12 cases and 3 fatalities, up from 4 cases and 1 death in the same period in 2025 (City Health Office). Barangay Estefania has two cases; ten other barangays each report one case, including 10, 16, 33, 39, Banago, Mandalagan, Sum-ag, Taculing, Singcang-Airport, and Felisa. Most complications and deaths are linked to health-seeking delays and denial of exposure. Residents with wading or contact with water or soil potentially contaminated by leptospira from rat or animal urine are urged to seek prophylaxis promptly and avoid floodwater or damp ground; segregate and manage garbage. The CHO also requests public participation to reduce rat populations and to report uncovered manholes, ditches, or open canals for proper management.

triage.headline_ja: バコロド市のレプトスピラ症患者数が200%増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・バコロド市でレプトスピラ症が前年同期比200%増加（12症例、3死亡）し、異常かつ予想外の上昇傾向を示しており、死亡を伴う中等度から重度の症例が確認されている。複数バランガイへの地域拡大と継続的な水環境への曝露リスクがあり、WPRO基準4項目該当。
triage.notes: バコロド市は水害のリスク地域であり、レプトスピラ症は動物尿による環境汚染と関連。当局は啓発活動と鼠族管理による環境改善対策を実施中。死亡事例の大部分が健康サービスへのアクセス遅延に関連しており、地域の医療システム対応能力に関する監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 중국 북서부, 구제역 혈청형 'SAT1' 첫 발생 보고
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Northwestern China reports first outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease serotype SAT1.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) serotype SAT1 detected in two cattle herds totaling about 6,200 cattle in Gansu and Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, China—the first SAT1 outbreak domestically. Laboratory confirmation led to culling and disinfection; 219 cattle tested positive for SAT1. Authorities warn SAT1 is highly contagious with mortality over 50% in young animals, and existing domestic vaccines do not provide cross-protection against SAT1. Investigations suggest introduction via the northwest border with Russia, Central Asia, and Mongolia, posing risks to beef, mutton, and pork production across western China, Russia, and Central Asia. China has secured an antigen bank for 300,000 animals and is evaluating further stockpiles to enable rapid response in case of domestic incursion.

triage.headline_ja: 中国北西部、口蹄疫血清型『SAT1』初発症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1の中国における初発症例であり、異常性と重症度（若齢動物の死亡率50%超）が高く、ロシア・中央アジア・モンゴルとの国境を介した導入の可能性から国際拡大リスクが存在するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではロシア・モンゴル・中央アジアが言及されているが、感染イベント自体の発生地は中国（甘粛省および新疆ウイグル自治区）であり、ロシア・モンゴルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。本イベントは4つすべてのIHR基準および5つすべてのWPRO基準に該当し、動物疾患（牛6,200頭が被災）であるが、畜産物供給チェーンへの影響から公衆衛生関心事となる可能性が高い。既存国内ワクチンが交差防御を提供しないという管理上の課題も注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Fontilles forma agents locals contra la lepra en aldees aïllades de l'Amazones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fontilles trains local agents to combat leprosy in isolated Amazon villages.
article.articleSummary: Fontilles trains local health agents to combat leprosy (Hansen's disease) in seven isolated indigenous villages along the Marmelos River in the Brazilian Amazon. The Valencia-based Fontilles foundation, active since 1902, leads a 2026 international cooperation project with the Alfredo da Matta Foundation for Tropical Dermatology and Venereology and Manaus Indigenous Health District (Saúde Indígena) to provide technical assistance and training for prevention and early diagnosis of leprosy and other skin diseases in indigenous Amazon communities. Dermatologist Sofia Ezsol Lendvai, collaborating with Fontilles, visited the area in recent weeks to reinforce agent training and oversee a river-based case-detection campaign. Travel by river and canoe enabled access to remote settlements, enabling detection of new leprosy cases and follow-up of previously registered individuals. The project aims to strengthen local capacity and early case finding in indigenous Amazon communities.

triage.headline_ja: Fontilles がアマゾン奥地の孤立した村でハンセン病対策のための地域保健職員養成を実施
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は制御可能な疾患で死亡率も低いが、アマゾンの先住民コミュニティでの継続的曝露と早期診断の課題が存在。記事は国際協力プロジェクトとしての取り組みを記述しており、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の新規発生アラートではなく、既知の風土病（ハンセン病）に対する国際協力プロジェクトの実施報告。アマゾンの先住民コミュニティでの継続的曝露と診断強化が主題。スペイン（バレンシア）の Fontilles 財団が主導するが、実際のイベント発生地はブラジル・アマゾン地域のみ。

article.articleHeadline: BRIN Warns of Possible Return of Plague in Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis-caused plague persists in Indonesia’s enzootic zones with rats and fleas as reservoirs and vectors. No human cases have been reported for more than a decade, but BRIN warns the disease may be in a 'silent period' and could re-emerge. Java's plague focus areas include Pasuruan, Boyolali, Sleman, and Bandung. Transmission to humans occurs via infected fleas; plague reservoirs (rats) are widely present across the country. Environmental changes—deforestation, land-use shifts, and rapid population growth—disrupt ecosystems and bring rodent habitats closer to people, while climate change may boost flea populations. Authorities urge stronger integrated surveillance across humans, animals, and vectors, along with improved sanitation and monitoring of former endemic zones. The study, Environmental Changes and Risk of Plague Epidemics in Indonesia, is a BRIN–Health Ministry collaboration with partners from China and France.

triage.headline_ja: BRINがインドネシアにおけるペスト再発の可能性について警告
triage.triage_reason: ペスト（Yersinia pestis）はIHR通知対象疾患であり、インドネシアにおける風土病化した保有動物（ラット）と媒介動物（ノミ）の存在が確認されている。ただし、過去10年以上ヒト患者の報告がなく、再発リスクは潜在的段階であるため、現段階ではWATCHが適切。
triage.notes: 記事は過去10年以上ヒト患者がない状況を強調しており、現在の直接的な流行状況ではなく将来的なリスク警告である。ただし、環境変化（森林破壊、土地利用の変化、人口増加）により、ラットの生息地が人間に近づいている点、気候変動がノミ個体群を増加させる可能性がある点から、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。BRIN（インドネシア研究革新庁）と保健省による公式警告であり政治的関心が高い。中国とフランスの研究機関も関与しており国際協力の側面あり。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo bệnh viêm não mô cầu sau 4 trường hợp tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health issues guidance on meningococcal meningitis following four fatalities.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health, on April 13, 2026, issued guidance on meningococcal meningitis following four fatalities. The infection, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, remains a concern, mainly affecting children under 15 (about 46% of cases); cases are scattered across communities with no concentrated outbreak yet. The current year shows a rising trend compared with the same period in 2025, which recorded 14 cases. Transmission is primarily via direct contact with nasal/throat secretions. The disease can rapidly progress to meningitis or septicemia, with potential long-term complications or death if untreated. The guidance emphasizes vaccination as part of prevention, alongside hygiene measures: regular handwashing, nasal/oral rinsing with antiseptics, wearing masks in public, limiting contact with the sick, environmental cleaning and good ventilation, and maintaining nutrition and physical activity. Seek prompt medical care for fever, headache, nausea, neck stiffness, or hemorrhagic rash.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム厚生省、4人の死亡例に続き髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に関するガイダンスを発表
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による4人の死亡、前年同時期比での患者数増加傾向、15歳未満の児童への影響が高い（46%）など、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準2つ以上該当。ベトナム厚生省による公式ガイダンス発出から、政府の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムで実際に発生している髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の死亡例および患者数増加傾向を報告。ベトナム厚生省による公式ガイダンス発出は政府対応の準備状況を示唆。国内分散例であるが、前年比での増加傾向と4人の死亡確認は WPRO スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当し、フルRRA実施の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ashram School Students Hit by Vomiting Outbreak In Mayurbhanj | Kanak News Shorts
article.articleSummary: As of 13 April 2026, Kakabandh Ashram School in Rasagovindpur block, Mayurbhanj district, Odisha, reports a vomiting and stomach-pain outbreak affecting more than 100 students; initially about 60 were affected. Symptoms include vomiting, stomach pain, and headache. The incident is treated as a health emergency with serious food-safety concerns. All affected students have been admitted to Rasagovindpur Community Health Centre for treatment. A medical team is at the hostel premises to investigate the cause and provide immediate care. The outbreak is suspected to be due to contaminated or unsafe food served at the hostel, with authorities conducting rapid assessment to identify the infection source and prevent further cases. No laboratory confirmation details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: アシュラム学校の学生が、マユルバンジで嘔吐の流行に見舞われています
triage.triage_reason: 嘔吐と腹痛の異常な集団発生（100人以上の学生が影響）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に合致するが、病原体が特定されていない（Unknown Illness）ため、情報確認が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 病原体が特定されていない（Unknown Illness）ため、フルRRA前に病原体同定と確定診断が重要。食中毒が疑われているが、感染症の可能性も排除できない。学校寮という限定的な環境での発生のため、国際的なリスクは現時点で低い。続報で病原体の特定と感染経路の確認が必須。
